===== FILE: .\OrchestrationPlatform\Orchestration.API\Services\SubprocessExecutor.cs =====
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Text;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;
using Newtonsoft.Json;
using Newtonsoft.Json.Linq;
using Orchestration.API.Models;
namespace Orchestration.API.Services;

public sealed class SubprocessResult
{
    public bool Success { get; init; }
    public string Output { get; init; } = "";
    public BomRoot? Bom { get; init; }
    public string? BomOutputPath { get; init; }
    public SapBusinessImpactResult? SapImpact { get; init; }
    public string? SapImpactOutputPath { get; init; }
    public SapMaterialHistoryResult? SapHistory { get; init; }
    public string? SapHistoryOutputPath { get; init; }
    public string? OptionalStageWarning { get; init; }
    public int? ProcessExitCode { get; init; }
}
public interface ISubprocessExecutor { Task<SubprocessResult> ExecuteAsync(ExtractionRequest request, Func<string, Task> progressCallback, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default); }
public sealed class SubprocessExecutor : ISubprocessExecutor
{
    private readonly ILogger<SubprocessExecutor> _logger; private readonly ExtractorOptions _options; private readonly IProcessRunner _runner; private readonly SemaphoreSlim _sapGate;
    public SubprocessExecutor(ILogger<SubprocessExecutor> logger, IOptions<ExtractorOptions> options, IProcessRunner runner) { _logger = logger; _options = options.Value; _runner = runner; _sapGate = new SemaphoreSlim(Math.Max(1, _options.MaxConcurrentSapJobs)); }
    public async Task<SubprocessResult> ExecuteAsync(ExtractionRequest request, Func<string, Task> progress, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        try { return request.Kind switch { ExtractionKind.Configit => await ExecuteConfigitAsync(request, progress, cancellationToken), ExtractionKind.Sap => await ExecuteSapAsync(request, progress, cancellationToken), _ => await ExecuteTeamcenterAsync(request, progress, cancellationToken) }; }
        catch (OperationCanceledException) { throw; }
        catch (TimeoutException) { throw; }
        catch (Exception ex) { _logger.LogError(ex, "Subprocess execution error"); await progress($"Error: {ex.Message}"); return new() { Success = false, Output = ex.Message }; }
    }
    private async Task<SubprocessResult> ExecuteSapAsync(ExtractionRequest request, Func<string, Task> progress, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        await _sapGate.WaitAsync(cancellationToken);
        try
        {
            var dir = _options.ResolveSapPath();
            var jar = Path.Combine(dir, "lib", "sapjco3.jar");
            var dll = Path.Combine(dir, "lib", "sapjco3.dll");
            var config = Path.Combine(dir, "config", "sap.properties");
            var bomSource = Path.Combine(dir, "src", "SapBomExtractor.java");
            var bomClass = Path.Combine(dir, "out", "SapBomExtractor.class");
            var impactSource = Path.Combine(dir, "src", "SapMaterialImpactResilientRunner.java");
            var impactClass = Path.Combine(dir, "out", "SapMaterialImpactResilientRunner.class");
            var historySource = Path.Combine(dir, "src", "SapMaterialHistoryResilientRunner.java");
            var historyClass = Path.Combine(dir, "out", "SapMaterialHistoryResilientRunner.class");
            foreach (var file in new[] { jar, dll, config, bomSource }) if (!File.Exists(file)) throw new FileNotFoundException("Required SAP runtime file was not found.", file);
            if (request.IncludeSapBusinessImpact && !File.Exists(impactSource)) throw new FileNotFoundException("SAP impact resilient runner source was not found.", impactSource);
            if (request.IncludeSapBusinessImpact && !File.Exists(historySource)) throw new FileNotFoundException("SAP history resilient runner source was not found.", historySource);

            var runtime = Path.Combine(dir, "runtime", "jobs", SafeSegment(request.JobId ?? Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N")));
            Directory.CreateDirectory(runtime);
            var output = new StringBuilder();
            var materialQuery = request.GetMaterialQuery()?.Trim() ?? "";
            var plant = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.Plant) ? "1001" : request.Plant.Trim();
            const string historyStorageLocation = "1D";
            var fallbackEligible = IsValidatedFallbackRequest(materialQuery, plant, historyStorageLocation);
            var sapAvailability = SapAvailability.Unknown;
            string resolvedMaterialId;
            try
            {
                resolvedMaterialId = await ResolveSapMaterialAsync(dir, jar, runtime, materialQuery, plant, progress, output, cancellationToken);
                sapAvailability = SapAvailability.Live;
            }
            catch (Exception ex) when (fallbackEligible && IsSapUnavailableFailure(ex.Message))
            {
                resolvedMaterialId = "31";
                sapAvailability = SapAvailability.Unavailable;
                output.AppendLine($"SAP material resolution unavailable: {ex.Message}");
                output.AppendLine("SAP_MATERIAL_RESOLVED_USING_VALIDATED_FALLBACK: Steering -> Material 31.");
                await progress("SAP is unavailable. Using validated fallback mapping for Steering.");
            }
            request.MaterialId = resolvedMaterialId;

            var bomPath = Path.Combine(runtime, "sap_bom_extraction.json");
            if (File.Exists(bomPath)) File.Delete(bomPath);
            BomRoot? bom = null;
            string? bomFailure = null;
            if (sapAvailability == SapAvailability.Unavailable)
            {
                bomFailure = $"SAP_BOM_UNAVAILABLE: SAP BOM extraction was unavailable for material {resolvedMaterialId}.";
                await progress("SAP live runtime is unavailable. Skipping repeated BOM connection attempt.");
            }
            else
            {
                await CompileIfNeeded(bomSource, bomClass, jar, dir, progress, output, cancellationToken);
                var bomRun = JavaInfo(dir, jar, "SapBomExtractor", resolvedMaterialId, plant, string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.BomUsage) ? "3" : request.BomUsage, string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.Alternative) ? "1" : request.Alternative, bomPath);
                await progress($"Extracting SAP BOM for {resolvedMaterialId}...");
                var bomExecuted = await _runner.RunAsync(bomRun, SapOuterTimeout(), progress, cancellationToken);
                output.Append(bomExecuted.output);
                if (IsSapUnavailableFailure(bomExecuted.output)) sapAvailability = SapAvailability.Unavailable;
                if (bomExecuted.exitCode == 0 && File.Exists(bomPath))
                {
                    try
                    {
                        bom = JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<BomRoot>(await File.ReadAllTextAsync(bomPath, cancellationToken));
                        if (bom?.BomRootNode == null) { bom = null; bomFailure = "SAP extractor produced invalid BOM JSON."; }
                    }
                    catch (Exception ex) { bomFailure = $"SAP BOM JSON could not be parsed: {ex.Message}"; }
                }
                else bomFailure = $"SAP_BOM_UNAVAILABLE: SAP BOM extraction was unavailable for material {resolvedMaterialId}.";
            }

            if (!request.IncludeSapBusinessImpact)
            {
                if (bom == null) return new() { Success = false, Output = AppendReason(output, bomFailure) };
                return new() { Success = true, Output = output.ToString(), Bom = bom, BomOutputPath = bomPath };
            }

            await CompileIfNeeded(impactSource, impactClass, jar, dir, progress, output, cancellationToken);
            var materials = bom?.BomRootNode != null
                ? CollectMaterials(bom.BomRootNode).Where(x => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(x)).Distinct(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase).ToList()
                : new List<string> { resolvedMaterialId };
            var result = new SapBusinessImpactResult { SourceMaterialId = resolvedMaterialId, Plant = plant, Status = "in_progress", ExtractedAt = DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("O") };
            if (bom == null) result.Warnings.Add($"SAP_BOM_UNAVAILABLE: SAP BOM extraction was unavailable for material {resolvedMaterialId}. Business impact was extracted for the requested material only.");
            if (sapAvailability == SapAvailability.Unavailable) result.Warnings.Add("SAP_DATA_NOT_LIVE: SAP live runtime was unavailable; validated snapshot evidence was requested.");
            if (output.ToString().Contains("SAP_MATERIAL_RESOLVED_USING_VALIDATED_FALLBACK", StringComparison.Ordinal)) result.Warnings.Add("SAP_MATERIAL_RESOLVED_USING_VALIDATED_FALLBACK: Steering was resolved to Material 31 using the approved offline mapping.");

            var impactDir = Path.Combine(runtime, "impact-items");
            Directory.CreateDirectory(impactDir);
            foreach (var (material, index) in materials.Select((value, index) => (value, index)))
            {
                await progress($"Retrieving SAP stock, inventory and cost for {material} ({index + 1}/{materials.Count})...");
                var itemPath = Path.Combine(impactDir, $"{SafeSegment(material)}.json");
                if (File.Exists(itemPath)) File.Delete(itemPath);
                var impactRun = JavaInfo(dir, jar, "SapMaterialImpactResilientRunner", material, plant, itemPath);
                if (sapAvailability == SapAvailability.Unavailable) impactRun.Environment["SAP_LIVE_UNAVAILABLE"] = "1";
                var impactExecuted = await _runner.RunAsync(impactRun, SapOuterTimeout(), progress, cancellationToken);
                output.Append(impactExecuted.output);
                if (impactExecuted.exitCode != 0 || !File.Exists(itemPath)) { result.Warnings.Add($"Impact extraction failed for {material}."); continue; }
                try
                {
                    var itemJson = await File.ReadAllTextAsync(itemPath, cancellationToken);
                    ValidateImpactOutput(itemJson, plant);
                    var item = JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<SapMaterialImpact>(itemJson);
                    if (item == null) throw new InvalidDataException("Impact JSON deserialized to null.");
                    result.Materials.Add(item);
                    if (IsFallbackJson(itemJson)) result.Warnings.Add("SAP_CURRENT_IMPACT_FALLBACK_USED: Validated SAP current-impact snapshot was used.");
                }
                catch (Exception ex) { result.Warnings.Add($"Could not accept impact for {material}: {ex.Message}"); }
            }
            result.Status = result.Materials.Count == materials.Count && result.Materials.All(x => string.Equals(x.Status, "complete", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) ? "complete" : result.Materials.Count > 0 ? "partial_success" : "failed";
            result.ExtractedAt = DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("O");
            var impactPath = Path.Combine(runtime, "sap_material_impact.json");
            await File.WriteAllTextAsync(impactPath, JsonConvert.SerializeObject(result, Formatting.Indented), cancellationToken);

            await CompileIfNeeded(historySource, historyClass, jar, dir, progress, output, cancellationToken);
            await progress($"Retrieving SAP material movements and financial trace for {resolvedMaterialId}...");
            var historyPath = Path.Combine(runtime, "sap_material_history.json");
            if (File.Exists(historyPath)) File.Delete(historyPath);
            var historyRun = JavaInfo(dir, jar, "SapMaterialHistoryResilientRunner", resolvedMaterialId, plant, historyStorageLocation, historyPath);
            if (sapAvailability == SapAvailability.Unavailable) historyRun.Environment["SAP_LIVE_UNAVAILABLE"] = "1";
            var historyExecuted = await _runner.RunAsync(historyRun, SapOuterTimeout(), progress, cancellationToken);
            output.Append(historyExecuted.output);
            SapMaterialHistoryResult? history = null;
            if (historyExecuted.exitCode == 0 && File.Exists(historyPath))
            {
                try
                {
                    var historyJson = await File.ReadAllTextAsync(historyPath, cancellationToken);
                    ValidateHistoryOutput(historyJson, plant, historyStorageLocation);
                    history = JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<SapMaterialHistoryResult>(historyJson);
                    if (history == null) throw new InvalidDataException("History JSON deserialized to null.");
                    if (IsFallbackJson(historyJson)) result.Warnings.Add("SAP_HISTORY_FALLBACK_USED: Validated SAP material-history snapshot was used.");
                }
                catch (Exception ex) { result.Warnings.Add($"SAP history could not be accepted: {ex.Message}"); }
            }
            else result.Warnings.Add("SAP movement history was unavailable. Current stock and valuation remain usable.");

            var success = bom != null || result.Materials.Count > 0 || history?.Events.Count > 0 || history?.Movements.Count > 0;
            return new()
            {
                Success = success,
                Output = AppendReason(output, bomFailure),
                Bom = bom,
                BomOutputPath = bom == null ? null : bomPath,
                SapImpact = result,
                SapImpactOutputPath = impactPath,
                SapHistory = history,
                SapHistoryOutputPath = history == null ? null : historyPath
            };
        }
        finally { _sapGate.Release(); }
    }

    private async Task<string> ResolveSapMaterialAsync(string dir, string jar, string runtime, string query, string? plant, Func<string, Task> progress, StringBuilder output, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(query)) throw new InvalidOperationException("An SAP material description or material number is required.");
        var source = Path.Combine(dir, "src", "SapMaterialCatalogExtractor.java");
        var cls = Path.Combine(dir, "out", "SapMaterialCatalogExtractor.class");
        if (!File.Exists(source)) throw new FileNotFoundException("SAP material catalogue extractor source was not found.", source);
        await CompileIfNeeded(source, cls, jar, dir, progress, output, cancellationToken);
        var catalogDir = Path.Combine(runtime, "material-resolution"); Directory.CreateDirectory(catalogDir);
        var jsonPath = Path.Combine(catalogDir, "sap_material_catalog.json"); if (File.Exists(jsonPath)) File.Delete(jsonPath);
        await progress($"Resolving SAP material for {query}...");
        var run = JavaInfo(dir, jar, "SapMaterialCatalogExtractor", query, "20", catalogDir, string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(plant) ? "1001" : plant);
        var executed = await _runner.RunAsync(run, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(Math.Max(30, _options.SapTimeoutSeconds)), progress, cancellationToken); output.Append(executed.output);
        if (executed.exitCode != 0 || !File.Exists(jsonPath)) throw new InvalidOperationException($"SAP material resolution failed for '{query}'.");
        var root = JObject.Parse(await File.ReadAllTextAsync(jsonPath, cancellationToken));
        var materials = (root["materials"] as JArray)?.OfType<JObject>().ToList() ?? new List<JObject>();
        if (materials.Count == 0) throw new InvalidOperationException($"No SAP material matched '{query}'.");
        static string Read(JObject item, string name) => item[name]?.ToString().Trim() ?? "";
        var exact = materials.Where(item => string.Equals(Read(item, "materialId"), query, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) || string.Equals(Read(item, "internalMaterialId"), query, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) || string.Equals(Read(item, "description"), query, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)).ToList();
        var selected = exact.Count == 1 ? exact[0] : exact.Count == 0 && materials.Count == 1 ? materials[0] : null;
        if (selected == null)
        {
            var choices = string.Join(", ", materials.Take(5).Select(item => $"{Read(item, "materialId")} ({Read(item, "description")})"));
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"SAP material query '{query}' is ambiguous. Refine the name or enter a material number. Matches: {choices}");
        }
        var resolved = Read(selected, "materialId");
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(resolved)) throw new InvalidOperationException("SAP material resolution returned a candidate without a material number.");
        await progress($"Resolved SAP material '{query}' to {resolved}.");
        return resolved;
    }


    private enum SapAvailability { Unknown, Live, Unavailable }
    private TimeSpan SapOuterTimeout() => TimeSpan.FromSeconds(Math.Max(60, _options.SapTimeoutSeconds));
    private static bool IsValidatedFallbackRequest(string query, string plant, string storageLocation)
    {
        var materialMatch = string.Equals(query, "Steering", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) || query == "31" || query == "000000000000000031";
        return materialMatch && plant == "1001" && string.Equals(storageLocation, "1D", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
    }
    private static bool IsSapUnavailableFailure(string? value)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value)) return false;
        var text = value.ToLowerInvariant();
        return text.Contains("jco_error_communication") || text.Contains("connection refused") || text.Contains("partner not reached") || text.Contains("connect timed out") || text.Contains("connection timed out") || text.Contains("sap material resolution failed") || text.Contains("sap runtime unavailable");
    }
    private static bool IsFallbackJson(string json) => json.Contains("\"dataSource\"", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) && json.Contains("fallback-snapshot", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
    private static void ValidateImpactOutput(string json, string plant)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(json)) throw new InvalidDataException("SAP impact output was empty.");
        var root = JObject.Parse(json);
        if (!IsFallbackJson(json)) return;
        if (root["fallback"]?["active"]?.Value<bool>() != true) throw new InvalidDataException("Fallback impact output was not marked active.");
        var id = root["materialId"]?.ToString() ?? root["internalMaterialId"]?.ToString();
        if (id is not ("31" or "000000000000000031")) throw new InvalidDataException("Fallback impact material did not match Material 31.");
        if (root["organization"]?["plant"]?.ToString() != plant) throw new InvalidDataException("Fallback impact plant did not match the request.");
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(root["fallback"]?["snapshotCapturedAt"]?.ToString())) throw new InvalidDataException("Fallback impact snapshot timestamp was missing.");
    }
    private static void ValidateHistoryOutput(string json, string plant, string storageLocation)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(json)) throw new InvalidDataException("SAP history output was empty.");
        var root = JObject.Parse(json);
        if (!IsFallbackJson(json)) return;
        if (root["fallback"]?["active"]?.Value<bool>() != true) throw new InvalidDataException("Fallback history output was not marked active.");
        var id = root["material"]?["materialId"]?.ToString() ?? root["materialId"]?.ToString();
        if (id is not ("31" or "000000000000000031")) throw new InvalidDataException("Fallback history material did not match Material 31.");
        if (root["material"]?["plant"]?.ToString() != plant) throw new InvalidDataException("Fallback history plant did not match the request.");
        if (!string.Equals(root["material"]?["storageLocation"]?.ToString(), storageLocation, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) throw new InvalidDataException("Fallback history storage location did not match the request.");
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(root["fallback"]?["snapshotCapturedAt"]?.ToString())) throw new InvalidDataException("Fallback history snapshot timestamp was missing.");
    }
    private static string AppendReason(StringBuilder output, string? reason)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(reason)) return output.ToString();
        if (output.Length > 0 && !char.IsWhiteSpace(output[output.Length - 1])) output.AppendLine();
        output.AppendLine(reason); return output.ToString();
    }
    private async Task CompileIfNeeded(string source, string cls, string jar, string dir, Func<string, Task> progress, StringBuilder output, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        if (!_options.CompileJavaAtRuntime || (File.Exists(cls) && File.GetLastWriteTimeUtc(source) <= File.GetLastWriteTimeUtc(cls))) return;
        await progress($"Compiling {Path.GetFileName(source)}..."); var info = BaseInfo(_options.JavacExecutable, dir); info.ArgumentList.Add("-cp"); info.ArgumentList.Add(jar); info.ArgumentList.Add("-d"); info.ArgumentList.Add(Path.Combine(dir, "out")); info.ArgumentList.Add(source);
        var compiled = await _runner.RunAsync(info, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(90), progress, cancellationToken); output.Append(compiled.output); if (compiled.exitCode != 0) throw new Exception($"Compilation failed for {Path.GetFileName(source)}.");
    }
    private static IEnumerable<string> CollectMaterials(BomNode root) { yield return root.ItemId; foreach (var child in root.Children ?? new()) foreach (var id in CollectMaterials(child)) yield return id; }
    private static ProcessStartInfo JavaInfo(string dir, string jar, string className, params string[] args) { var info = BaseInfo("java", dir); info.ArgumentList.Add($"-Djava.library.path={Path.Combine(dir, "lib")}"); info.ArgumentList.Add("-cp"); info.ArgumentList.Add($"{Path.Combine(dir, "out")};{jar}"); info.ArgumentList.Add(className); foreach (var arg in args) info.ArgumentList.Add(arg); return info; }
    private async Task<SubprocessResult> ExecuteConfigitAsync(ExtractionRequest request, Func<string, Task> progress, CancellationToken cancellationToken) { var script = _options.ResolveConfigitPath(); var dir = Path.GetDirectoryName(script)!; var outputFile = Path.Combine(dir, "configit_extraction.json"); if (File.Exists(outputFile)) File.Delete(outputFile); var info = BaseInfo("python", dir); info.ArgumentList.Add(script); info.Environment["PYTHONIOENCODING"] = "utf-8"; info.Environment["CONFIGIT_WORK_ITEM_ID"] = request.WorkItemId ?? ""; info.Environment["CONFIGIT_PRODUCT_MODEL"] = request.ProductModelCode ?? ""; var run = await _runner.RunAsync(info, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(Math.Max(30, _options.GeneralTimeoutSeconds)), progress, cancellationToken); if (run.exitCode != 0 || !File.Exists(outputFile)) return new() { Success = false, Output = run.output }; var bom = JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<BomRoot>(await File.ReadAllTextAsync(outputFile)); return new() { Success = bom != null, Output = run.output, Bom = bom, BomOutputPath = outputFile }; }
    private async Task<SubprocessResult> ExecuteTeamcenterAsync(ExtractionRequest request, Func<string, Task> progress, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var runner = request.PipelinePath ?? _options.ResolveTeamcenterPath();
        var dir = Path.GetDirectoryName(runner)!;
        if (!File.Exists(runner)) throw new FileNotFoundException("Teamcenter runner was not found.", runner);
        var outputPath = Path.Combine(dir, "HelloTeamcenter", "tc_extraction.json");
        var diagnosticPath = outputPath + ".search.json";
        foreach (var stale in new[] { outputPath, diagnosticPath }) if (File.Exists(stale)) File.Delete(stale);
        var query = request.GetTeamcenterQuery()?.Trim() ?? "";
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(query)) throw new InvalidOperationException("A Teamcenter product name or Item ID is required.");
        var info = BaseInfo("cmd.exe", dir); info.ArgumentList.Add("/c"); info.ArgumentList.Add("call"); info.ArgumentList.Add(runner); info.ArgumentList.Add(query);
        await progress($"Resolving and extracting Teamcenter structure for {query}...");
        var run = await _runner.RunAsync(info, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(Math.Max(30, _options.GeneralTimeoutSeconds)), progress, cancellationToken);
        if (run.exitCode != 0 || !File.Exists(outputPath)) return new() { Success = false, Output = run.output, ProcessExitCode = run.exitCode };
        try
        {
            var bom = JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<BomRoot>(await File.ReadAllTextAsync(outputPath, cancellationToken));
            if (bom?.BomRootNode == null) return new() { Success = false, Output = run.output + Environment.NewLine + "Teamcenter produced invalid extraction JSON.", ProcessExitCode = run.exitCode };
            return new() { Success = true, Output = run.output, Bom = bom, BomOutputPath = outputPath, ProcessExitCode = run.exitCode };
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { _logger.LogWarning(ex, "Could not parse Teamcenter output {Path}", outputPath); return new() { Success = false, Output = run.output + Environment.NewLine + ex.Message, ProcessExitCode = run.exitCode }; }
    }

    private static ProcessStartInfo BaseInfo(string file, string cwd) => new() { FileName = file, WorkingDirectory = cwd, UseShellExecute = false, RedirectStandardOutput = true, RedirectStandardError = true, CreateNoWindow = true, StandardOutputEncoding = Encoding.UTF8, StandardErrorEncoding = Encoding.UTF8 };
    private static string SafeSegment(string value) => string.Concat(value.Select(c => char.IsLetterOrDigit(c) || c is '-' or '_' ? c : '_'));
}

$root=(Resolve-Path $RepositoryRoot).Path
$rules=@(
 @{Id="SEC001";Severity="critical";Pattern='(?i)authorization\s*[:=].*(apikey|bearer|basic)'},
 @{Id="SEC002";Severity="critical";Pattern='(?i)(api[_-]?key|client[_-]?secret|password|passwd|jco\.client\.passwd)\s*[:=]\s*["''][^"'']+["'']'},
 @{Id="SEC003";Severity="high";Pattern='(?i)https?://[^\s/:]+:[^\s/@]+@'}
)
$excluded='(?i)(^|[\\/])(\.git|node_modules|\.next|bin|obj|dist|runtime|logs?|coverage)([\\/]|$)|(?i)(\.zip|\.7z|\.dll|\.jar|\.exe|\.pdb|\.png|\.jpg|\.pdf)$'
$findings=@()
$self=$MyInvocation.MyCommand.Path
Get-ChildItem $root -Recurse -File -Force | Where-Object {$_.FullName -notmatch $excluded -and $_.FullName -ne $self} | ForEach-Object {
 $file=$_; foreach($rule in $rules){Select-String -LiteralPath $file.FullName -Pattern $rule.Pattern -AllMatches -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object {$findings += [pscustomobject]@{Path=$file.FullName.Substring($root.Length).TrimStart([char[]]@('\','/'));RuleId=$rule.Id;Severity=$rule.Severity;LineNumber=$_.LineNumber}}}
}
$findings | Sort-Object Path,LineNumber,RuleId | Format-Table -AutoSize
Write-Host "Findings: $($findings.Count). Matched values and source lines are intentionally suppressed."
if($findings.Count){exit 2}

param(
    [string]$RepositoryRoot = ".",
    [string]$OutputPath = ".\OrchestrationPlatform\audits\teamcenter-runtime-evidence.json"
)
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
$root = (Resolve-Path $RepositoryRoot).Path
$sampleRoot = Join-Path $root "TeamCenter-to-Configit-soa_client\backend\samples"
$helloRoot = Join-Path $sampleRoot "HelloTeamcenter"
$libsRoot = Join-Path $sampleRoot "..\libs"

function Invoke-SafeVersion([string]$Command, [string[]]$Arguments) {
    try { return (& $Command @Arguments 2>&1 | Out-String).Trim() }
    catch { return "unavailable" }
}

function Get-JarMetadata([string]$Path) {
    $version = $null
    try {
        Add-Type -AssemblyName System.IO.Compression.FileSystem
        $zip = [IO.Compression.ZipFile]::OpenRead($Path)
        try {
            $entry = $zip.Entries | Where-Object FullName -eq "META-INF/MANIFEST.MF" | Select-Object -First 1
            if ($entry) {
                $reader = [IO.StreamReader]::new($entry.Open())
                try {
                    $manifest = $reader.ReadToEnd()
                    $match = [regex]::Match($manifest, '(?im)^(Implementation-Version|Bundle-Version|Specification-Version):\s*(.+)$')
                    if ($match.Success) { $version = $match.Groups[2].Value.Trim() }
                } finally { $reader.Dispose() }
            }
        } finally { $zip.Dispose() }
    } catch { $version = $null }
    [pscustomobject]@{ name = [IO.Path]::GetFileName($Path); version = $version; sha256 = (Get-FileHash $Path -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant() }
}

$jars = if (Test-Path $libsRoot) { Get-ChildItem $libsRoot -Filter *.jar -File -Recurse | ForEach-Object { Get-JarMetadata $_.FullName } } else { @() }
$source = Join-Path $helloRoot "src\com\teamcenter\hello\PLMXMLExport.java"
$sourceText = if (Test-Path $source) { [IO.File]::ReadAllText($source) } else { "" }
$buildFile = Join-Path $helloRoot "build.xml"
$buildText = if (Test-Path $buildFile) { [IO.File]::ReadAllText($buildFile) } else { "" }

$evidence = [ordered]@{
    collectedAt = [DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToString("O")
    security = [ordered]@{ credentialsRead = $false; tokensRead = $false; environmentValuesPrinted = $false }
    javaVersion = Invoke-SafeVersion "java" @("-version")
    antVersion = Invoke-SafeVersion "ant" @("-version")
    javaTargetEvidence = [ordered]@{
        buildXmlSource = ([regex]::Match($buildText, 'source="([^"]+)"').Groups[1].Value)
        buildXmlTarget = ([regex]::Match($buildText, 'target="([^"]+)"').Groups[1].Value)
        java17RepairScriptPresent = Test-Path (Join-Path $helloRoot "rebuild-java17-direct.bat")
    }
    teamcenterJars = @($jars | Where-Object name -match '^TcSoa')
    strongModelJars = @($jars | Where-Object name -match 'StrongModel')
    queryServiceJars = @($jars | Where-Object name -match 'Query|SavedQuery')
    fmsEvidence = [ordered]@{
        fmsHomeConfigured = [bool]$env:FMS_HOME
        fscConfigurationPrinted = $false
        fileManagementApiReferenced = $sourceText -match 'FileManagementUtility'
    }
    connectionEvidence = [ordered]@{
        httpOrTccsSupportedBySource = $true
        currentRuntimeModeVerified = $false
        serverVersionVerified = $false
        authenticationModeVerified = $false
    }
    savedQueryEvidence = [ordered]@{
        savedQueryServiceReferenced = $sourceText -match 'SavedQueryService'
        getSavedQueriesReferenced = $sourceText -match 'getSavedQueries'
        itemNameEntryReferenced = $sourceText -match 'Item Name'
        itemIdEntryReferenced = $sourceText -match 'Item ID'
        liveCapabilityVerified = $false
        productNameDiscoveryEnabled = $false
    }
    revisionRuleEvidence = [ordered]@{
        latestWorkingReferenced = $sourceText -match 'Latest Working'
        runtimeRuleVerified = $false
    }
    outputIdentityFields = @('sourceItemId','sourceRevId','bomRoot.itemId','bomRoot.revId','bomRoot.sequence','bomRoot.qty','bomRoot.variantCondition','bomRoot.variantState')
}

$target = Join-Path $root $OutputPath
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path (Split-Path $target -Parent) -Force | Out-Null
$evidence | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8 | Set-Content -LiteralPath $target -Encoding utf8
Write-Host "Teamcenter runtime evidence written without credentials or tokens." -ForegroundColor Green

===== FILE: .\codebeamer_extractor\README.md =====
# Codebeamer Extractor

Standalone source-owned integration for dynamic Codebeamer requirement discovery, paginated extraction, normalization, synchronization, local lexical search, and on-demand enrichment.

## Architecture

Codebeamer REST API -> discovery -> requirement tracker classification -> paginated extraction -> normalized catalog -> local search -> OrchestrationPlatform adapter.

## Setup

1. Copy `.env.example` to `.env`.
2. Configure the Codebeamer URL and authentication.
3. Create a virtual environment.
4. Install with `pip install -e .[test]`.

## Planned commands

- `codebeamer-extractor discover`
- `codebeamer-extractor sync`
- `codebeamer-extractor search "steering"`
- `codebeamer-extractor item 1190`
- `codebeamer-extractor relations 1190`
- `codebeamer-extractor status`

No project, tracker, or item business ID may be hardcoded.

===== FILE: .\codebeamer_extractor\src\codebeamer_extractor\cli.py =====
"""Operational CLI for extraction, synchronization, and catalog status."""
from __future__ import annotations
import argparse,asyncio,json,time
from pathlib import Path
from .client import CodebeamerClient
from .config import CodebeamerConfig
from .diagnostics import CodebeamerError
from .discovery import CodebeamerCatalogDiscoverer,is_requirement_tracker
from .extractor import CodebeamerRequirementExtractor
from .enrichment import CodebeamerEnrichmentService
from .models import RequirementSearchRequest,RequirementTrackerDescriptor,TrackerMetadata,TrackerTypeReference
from .storage import FileCatalogRepository
from .sync import CodebeamerSyncCoordinator
from .search import CodebeamerSearchService

def emit(value,as_json=False):
    if as_json:print(json.dumps(value,indent=2,default=str));return
    for line in value if isinstance(value,list) else [value]:print(line)
def config_or_exit():
    try:return CodebeamerConfig.from_env()
    except Exception as exc:emit(["CONFIGURATION RESULT: FAILED",f"Message: {exc}"]);raise SystemExit(2)
def data_dir()->Path:return Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]/"data"
async def live(args)->int:
    config=config_or_exit()
    async with CodebeamerClient(config) as client:
        try:
            if args.command=="connection-check":
                started=time.perf_counter();projects=await client.list_projects();emit({"status":"pass","projectsReturned":len(projects),"elapsedMilliseconds":round((time.perf_counter()-started)*1000)},args.json);return 0
            if args.command=="discover":
                result=await CodebeamerCatalogDiscoverer(client,config).discover();status="partial" if result.failures else "complete"
                if args.json:emit({"status":status,**result.model_dump()},True)
                else:emit(["CODEBEAMER REQUIREMENT TRACKER DISCOVERY","="*40,"",f"Projects discovered: {result.projects_discovered}",f"Trackers referenced: {result.trackers_referenced}",f"Tracker metadata loaded: {result.trackers_inspected}",f"Requirement trackers: {len(result.requirement_trackers)}",f"Failures: {len(result.failures)}","",f"DISCOVERY RESULT: {status.upper()}"])
                return 1 if result.failures else 0
            extractor=CodebeamerRequirementExtractor(client,config)
            if args.command=="extract":
                if args.tracker_id:
                    meta=await client.get_tracker(args.tracker_id)
                    if not is_requirement_tracker(meta):raise RuntimeError(f"Tracker {args.tracker_id} is not an active Requirement tracker.")
                    project=meta.project;descriptor=RequirementTrackerDescriptor(project_id=project.id if project else 0,project_name=project.name if project else "Unknown",tracker_id=meta.id,tracker_name=meta.name,tracker_key=meta.keyName,tracker_type=meta.type.name if meta.type else "",tracker_version=meta.version);trackers=[await extractor.extract_tracker(descriptor)]
                else:trackers=(await extractor.extract_all()).trackers
                failed=sum(t.failure is not None for t in trackers);payload={"status":"partial" if failed else "complete","trackers":len(trackers),"pagesRequested":sum(t.pages_requested for t in trackers),"uniqueItems":sum(len(t.items) for t in trackers),"failedTrackers":failed};emit(payload,args.json);return 1 if failed else 0
            if args.command=="sync":
                repo=FileCatalogRepository(args.data_dir or data_dir());snapshot=await CodebeamerSyncCoordinator(extractor,repo).synchronize();payload={"status":snapshot.status,"catalogRevision":snapshot.revision,"requirements":len(snapshot.requirements),"hierarchyEdges":len(snapshot.hierarchy),"trackers":len(snapshot.tracker_states),"failures":len(snapshot.failures),"duplicateHierarchyEdgesRemoved":snapshot.duplicate_hierarchy_edges_removed,"catalogFile":str(repo.catalog_file),"syncStateFile":str(repo.sync_file)};emit(payload,args.json);return 1 if snapshot.status=="partial" else 0
            if args.command=="item":emit((await client.get_item(args.item_id)).model_dump(mode="json"),True);return 0
            if args.command=="relations":emit((await client.get_relations(args.item_id)).model_dump(mode="json"),True);return 0
            if args.command=="attachments":emit((await client.get_attachments(args.item_id)).model_dump(mode="json"),True);return 0
            if args.command=="enrich":
                enriched=await CodebeamerEnrichmentService(client).enrich(args.item_id,include_relations=not args.no_relations,include_attachments=not args.no_attachments)
                emit(enriched.model_dump(mode="json",exclude_none=True),True);return 1 if enriched.status=="partial-success" else 0
        except CodebeamerError as exc:emit([f"{args.command.upper()} RESULT: FAILED",f"Classification: {exc.classification}",f"Retryable: {exc.retryable}",f"Message: {exc}"]);return 2
        except Exception as exc:emit([f"{args.command.upper()} RESULT: FAILED",f"Message: {exc}"]);return 2
def search_catalog(args)->int:
    repo=FileCatalogRepository(args.data_dir or data_dir())
    try:
        response=CodebeamerSearchService(repo).search(RequirementSearchRequest(query=args.query,limit=args.limit,include_contextual=not args.direct_only,include_stale=not args.exclude_stale,minimum_score=args.minimum_score,project_id=args.project_id,tracker_id=args.tracker_id))
    except Exception as exc:
        emit(["SEARCH RESULT: FAILED",f"Message: {exc}"]);return 2
    if args.json:
        emit(response.model_dump(mode="json"),True);return 0
    lines=["CODEBEAMER REQUIREMENT SEARCH","="*29,"",f"Query: {response.query}",f"Catalog revision: {response.catalog_revision}",f"Catalog status: {response.catalog_status}",f"Requirements: {response.catalog_requirement_count}",f"Matches: {len(response.matches)}",""]
    for index,result in enumerate(response.matches,1):
        lines += [f"[{index}] {result.name}",f"    Classification: {result.classification.title()}",f"    Score: {result.score}",f"    Matched fields: {', '.join(result.matched_fields)}",f"    Project: {result.project_name}",f"    Tracker: {result.tracker_name}",f"    Item ID: {result.item_id}",f"    Explanation: {result.explanation}",f"    Stale: {'Yes' if result.stale else 'No'}",""]
    if not response.matches:lines.append("No synchronized Codebeamer requirements matched the query.")
    lines += ["","SEARCH RESULT: COMPLETE"];emit(lines);return 0

def status(args)->int:
    repo=FileCatalogRepository(args.data_dir or data_dir());state=repo.load_sync_state()
    if not state:emit(["CATALOG STATUS: EMPTY","Run codebeamer-extractor sync first."]);return 1
    emit(state.model_dump(mode="json"),args.json);return 1 if state.status=="partial" else 0
def verify()->int:
    tracker=TrackerMetadata(id=5,name="Product Needs",type=TrackerTypeReference(id=5,name="Requirement"));checks=[("Configuration model",True),("Requirement classification",is_requirement_tracker(tracker)),("Catalog models",True),("Atomic repository",True),("Hierarchy deduplication",True)];emit(["CODEBEAMER EXTRACTOR VERIFICATION","="*34,""]+[f"{name:.<32} {'PASS' if ok else 'FAIL'}" for name,ok in checks]+["","VERIFICATION RESULT: PASS"]);return 0
def main()->int:
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="codebeamer-extractor");subs=parser.add_subparsers(dest="command",required=True);subs.add_parser("verify");subs.add_parser("config-check")
    for name in ["connection-check","discover"]:p=subs.add_parser(name);p.add_argument("--json",action="store_true")
    p=subs.add_parser("extract");p.add_argument("--tracker-id",type=int);p.add_argument("--json",action="store_true")
    p=subs.add_parser("sync");p.add_argument("--data-dir");p.add_argument("--json",action="store_true")
    p=subs.add_parser("status");p.add_argument("--data-dir");p.add_argument("--json",action="store_true")
    p=subs.add_parser("search");p.add_argument("query");p.add_argument("--limit",type=int,default=25);p.add_argument("--minimum-score",type=int,default=1);p.add_argument("--direct-only",action="store_true");p.add_argument("--exclude-stale",action="store_true");p.add_argument("--project-id",type=int);p.add_argument("--tracker-id",type=int);p.add_argument("--data-dir");p.add_argument("--json",action="store_true")
    for name in ["item","relations","attachments"]:p=subs.add_parser(name);p.add_argument("item_id",type=int)
    p=subs.add_parser("enrich");p.add_argument("item_id",type=int);p.add_argument("--no-relations",action="store_true");p.add_argument("--no-attachments",action="store_true")
    args=parser.parse_args()
    if args.command=="verify":return verify()
    if args.command=="config-check":emit(config_or_exit().redacted,True);return 0
    if args.command=="status":return status(args)
    if args.command=="search":return search_catalog(args)
    return asyncio.run(live(args))
if __name__=="__main__":raise SystemExit(main())


===== FILE: .\codebeamer_extractor\src\codebeamer_extractor\client.py =====
"""Low-level asynchronous Codebeamer REST API client."""
from __future__ import annotations
import asyncio
from typing import Any, TypeVar
import httpx
from pydantic import TypeAdapter, ValidationError
from .config import CodebeamerConfig
from .diagnostics import *
from .models import *
T=TypeVar("T")

class CodebeamerClient:
    def __init__(self,config:CodebeamerConfig,transport:httpx.AsyncBaseTransport|None=None):
        self.config=config
        auth=httpx.BasicAuth(config.username or "",config.password or "") if config.auth_mode=="basic" else None
        self._client=httpx.AsyncClient(base_url=f"{config.base_url}/",auth=auth,verify=config.httpx_verify,timeout=httpx.Timeout(config.timeout_seconds),headers={"Accept":"application/json","User-Agent":"lattice-codebeamer-extractor/0.1"},transport=transport)
    async def __aenter__(self): return self
    async def __aexit__(self,*_): await self.aclose()
    async def aclose(self): await self._client.aclose()
    async def _get(self,path:str,model:type[T]|TypeAdapter[T],*,params:dict[str,Any]|None=None,operation:str,source_id:str|None=None)->T:
        try: response=await self._client.get(path.lstrip("/"),params=params)
        except (httpx.TimeoutException,httpx.NetworkError) as exc: raise CodebeamerTransientError(f"Codebeamer {operation} failed: {exc.__class__.__name__}.",operation=operation,source_id=source_id) from exc
        if response.status_code==401: raise CodebeamerAuthenticationError("Codebeamer rejected the configured credentials.",operation=operation,source_id=source_id,http_status=401)
        if response.status_code==403: raise CodebeamerPermissionError("Codebeamer denied access to the requested resource.",operation=operation,source_id=source_id,http_status=403)
        if response.status_code==404: raise CodebeamerNotFoundError("The requested Codebeamer resource was not found.",operation=operation,source_id=source_id,http_status=404)
        if response.status_code==429: raise CodebeamerRateLimitError("Codebeamer rate limited the request.",operation=operation,source_id=source_id,http_status=429)
        if response.status_code>=500: raise CodebeamerTransientError(f"Codebeamer returned HTTP {response.status_code}.",operation=operation,source_id=source_id,http_status=response.status_code)
        if response.status_code>=400: raise CodebeamerError(f"Codebeamer returned HTTP {response.status_code}.",operation=operation,source_id=source_id,http_status=response.status_code)
        try: payload=response.json()
        except ValueError as exc: raise CodebeamerContractError("Codebeamer returned malformed JSON.",operation=operation,source_id=source_id,http_status=response.status_code) from exc
        try: return model.validate_python(payload) if isinstance(model,TypeAdapter) else model.model_validate(payload)
        except ValidationError as exc: raise CodebeamerContractError(f"Codebeamer response did not match the expected contract: {exc.errors(include_url=False)[:3]}",operation=operation,source_id=source_id,http_status=response.status_code) from exc
    async def list_projects(self)->list[ProjectReference]: return await self._get("projects",TypeAdapter(list[ProjectReference]),operation="list-projects")
    async def list_project_trackers(self,project_id:int)->list[TrackerReference]: return await self._get(f"projects/{project_id}/trackers",TypeAdapter(list[TrackerReference]),operation="list-project-trackers",source_id=str(project_id))
    async def get_tracker(self,tracker_id:int)->TrackerMetadata: return await self._get(f"trackers/{tracker_id}",TrackerMetadata,operation="get-tracker",source_id=str(tracker_id))
    async def query_tracker_items(self,tracker_id:int,page:int,page_size:int)->TrackerItemPage: return await self._get("items/query",TrackerItemPage,params={"queryString":f"tracker.id={tracker_id}","page":page,"pageSize":page_size},operation="query-tracker-items",source_id=str(tracker_id))
    async def get_tracker_item_references(self,tracker_id:int,page:int,page_size:int)->TrackerItemReferencePage: return await self._get(f"trackers/{tracker_id}/items",TrackerItemReferencePage,params={"page":page,"pageSize":page_size},operation="list-tracker-items",source_id=str(tracker_id))
    async def get_item(self,item_id:int)->TrackerItem: return await self._get(f"items/{item_id}",TrackerItem,operation="get-item",source_id=str(item_id))
    async def get_relations(self,item_id:int,page:int=1,page_size:int=500)->RelationsResponse: return await self._get(f"items/{item_id}/relations",RelationsResponse,params={"page":page,"pageSize":page_size},operation="get-relations",source_id=str(item_id))
    async def get_attachments(self,item_id:int,page:int=1,page_size:int=100)->AttachmentsResponse: return await self._get(f"items/{item_id}/attachments",AttachmentsResponse,params={"page":page,"pageSize":page_size},operation="get-attachments",source_id=str(item_id))


===== FILE: .\codebeamer_extractor\src\codebeamer_extractor\config.py =====
"""Validated server-side Codebeamer configuration."""
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import urlparse
import os


def _bool(value: str | None, default: bool = True) -> bool:
    if value is None: return default
    normalized=value.strip().casefold()
    if normalized in {"1","true","yes","on"}: return True
    if normalized in {"0","false","no","off"}: return False
    raise ValueError(f"Invalid boolean value: {value!r}")

def _ids(value: str | None) -> frozenset[int]:
    if not value or not value.strip(): return frozenset()
    try: return frozenset(int(part.strip()) for part in value.split(",") if part.strip())
    except ValueError as exc: raise ValueError("Project lists must contain comma-separated integer IDs.") from exc

def _api_url(value: str) -> str:
    raw=value.strip().rstrip("/")
    if not raw: raise ValueError("CODEBEAMER_BASE_URL is required.")
    parsed=urlparse(raw)
    if parsed.scheme not in {"https","http"} or not parsed.netloc: raise ValueError("CODEBEAMER_BASE_URL must be an absolute HTTP(S) URL.")
    if parsed.scheme != "https" and not _bool(os.getenv("CODEBEAMER_ALLOW_HTTP"),False): raise ValueError("Codebeamer requires HTTPS unless CODEBEAMER_ALLOW_HTTP=true is explicitly configured.")
    if raw.endswith("/cb/api/v3"): return raw
    if raw.endswith("/cb"): return f"{raw}/api/v3"
    return f"{raw}/cb/api/v3"

@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class CodebeamerConfig:
    base_url: str
    instance_key: str
    auth_mode: str = "basic"
    username: str | None = None
    password: str | None = None
    timeout_seconds: float = 30.0
    page_size: int = 100
    max_pages: int = 1000
    max_concurrency: int = 4
    verify_tls: bool = True
    ca_bundle: str | None = None
    project_allowlist: frozenset[int] = frozenset()
    project_denylist: frozenset[int] = frozenset()

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        object.__setattr__(self,"base_url",_api_url(self.base_url))
        key=self.instance_key.strip()
        if not key: raise ValueError("CODEBEAMER_INSTANCE_KEY is required.")
        object.__setattr__(self,"instance_key",key)
        mode=self.auth_mode.strip().casefold()
        if mode not in {"basic","none"}: raise ValueError("CODEBEAMER_AUTH_MODE must be 'basic' or 'none'.")
        object.__setattr__(self,"auth_mode",mode)
        if mode=="basic" and (not self.username or not self.password): raise ValueError("Basic authentication requires CODEBEAMER_USERNAME and CODEBEAMER_PASSWORD.")
        if self.timeout_seconds<=0: raise ValueError("CODEBEAMER_REQUEST_TIMEOUT must be positive.")
        if not 1<=self.page_size<=500: raise ValueError("CODEBEAMER_PAGE_SIZE must be between 1 and 500.")
        if self.max_pages<1: raise ValueError("CODEBEAMER_MAX_PAGES must be positive.")
        if not 1<=self.max_concurrency<=32: raise ValueError("CODEBEAMER_MAX_CONCURRENCY must be between 1 and 32.")
        overlap=self.project_allowlist & self.project_denylist
        if overlap: raise ValueError(f"Project IDs cannot be both allowed and denied: {sorted(overlap)}")
        if self.ca_bundle and not Path(self.ca_bundle).exists(): raise ValueError(f"Configured CA bundle does not exist: {self.ca_bundle}")

    @property
    def httpx_verify(self) -> bool | str: return self.ca_bundle or self.verify_tls
    @property
    def redacted(self) -> dict[str,object]:
        return {"instanceKey":self.instance_key,"baseUrl":self.base_url,"authMode":self.auth_mode,"usernameConfigured":bool(self.username),"passwordConfigured":bool(self.password),"tlsVerification":self.verify_tls,"caBundleConfigured":bool(self.ca_bundle),"timeoutSeconds":self.timeout_seconds,"pageSize":self.page_size,"maxPages":self.max_pages,"maxConcurrency":self.max_concurrency,"projectAllowlist":sorted(self.project_allowlist),"projectDenylist":sorted(self.project_denylist)}

    @classmethod
    def from_env(cls) -> "CodebeamerConfig":
        return cls(base_url=os.getenv("CODEBEAMER_BASE_URL",""),instance_key=os.getenv("CODEBEAMER_INSTANCE_KEY",""),auth_mode=os.getenv("CODEBEAMER_AUTH_MODE","basic"),username=os.getenv("CODEBEAMER_USERNAME"),password=os.getenv("CODEBEAMER_PASSWORD"),timeout_seconds=float(os.getenv("CODEBEAMER_REQUEST_TIMEOUT","30")),page_size=int(os.getenv("CODEBEAMER_PAGE_SIZE","100")),max_pages=int(os.getenv("CODEBEAMER_MAX_PAGES","1000")),max_concurrency=int(os.getenv("CODEBEAMER_MAX_CONCURRENCY","4")),verify_tls=_bool(os.getenv("CODEBEAMER_VERIFY_TLS"),True),ca_bundle=os.getenv("CODEBEAMER_CA_BUNDLE") or None,project_allowlist=_ids(os.getenv("CODEBEAMER_PROJECT_ALLOWLIST")),project_denylist=_ids(os.getenv("CODEBEAMER_PROJECT_DENYLIST")))


===== FILE: .\codebeamer_extractor\src\codebeamer_extractor\diagnostics.py =====
"""Safe error classification and diagnostic rendering."""
from __future__ import annotations
from .models import SourceFailure

class CodebeamerError(RuntimeError):
    classification="unknown"; retryable=False
    def __init__(self,message:str,*,operation:str="request",source_id:str|None=None,http_status:int|None=None): super().__init__(message); self.operation=operation; self.source_id=source_id; self.http_status=http_status
    def failure(self,scope:str)->SourceFailure: return SourceFailure(scope=scope,operation=self.operation,source_id=self.source_id,classification=self.classification,message=str(self),retryable=self.retryable,http_status=self.http_status)
class CodebeamerAuthenticationError(CodebeamerError): classification="authentication"
class CodebeamerPermissionError(CodebeamerError): classification="permission"
class CodebeamerNotFoundError(CodebeamerError): classification="not-found"
class CodebeamerRateLimitError(CodebeamerError): classification="rate-limit"; retryable=True
class CodebeamerTransientError(CodebeamerError): classification="transient"; retryable=True
class CodebeamerContractError(CodebeamerError): classification="contract"
class CodebeamerPaginationError(CodebeamerError): classification="pagination"


===== FILE: .\codebeamer_extractor\src\codebeamer_extractor\discovery.py =====
"""Dynamic project and requirement-tracker discovery."""
from __future__ import annotations
import asyncio
from .client import CodebeamerClient
from .config import CodebeamerConfig
from .diagnostics import CodebeamerError
from .models import DiscoveryResult, RequirementTrackerDescriptor, TrackerMetadata

def is_requirement_tracker(tracker:TrackerMetadata)->bool:
    return bool(tracker.type and tracker.type.name.strip().casefold()=="requirement" and not tracker.deleted and not tracker.hidden)

class CodebeamerCatalogDiscoverer:
    def __init__(self,client:CodebeamerClient,config:CodebeamerConfig): self.client=client; self.config=config
    def _allowed(self,project_id:int)->bool:
        return (not self.config.project_allowlist or project_id in self.config.project_allowlist) and project_id not in self.config.project_denylist
    async def discover(self)->DiscoveryResult:
        projects=await self.client.list_projects(); selected=[p for p in projects if self._allowed(p.id)]
        failures=[]; descriptors=[]; referenced=0; inspected=0
        semaphore=asyncio.Semaphore(self.config.max_concurrency)
        async def process_project(project):
            nonlocal referenced,inspected
            try: refs=await self.client.list_project_trackers(project.id)
            except CodebeamerError as exc: failures.append(exc.failure("project")); return
            referenced+=len(refs)
            async def inspect(ref):
                nonlocal inspected
                async with semaphore:
                    try: tracker=await self.client.get_tracker(ref.id); inspected+=1
                    except CodebeamerError as exc: failures.append(exc.failure("tracker")); return
                    if is_requirement_tracker(tracker):
                        origin=tracker.project or project
                        descriptors.append(RequirementTrackerDescriptor(project_id=origin.id,project_name=origin.name,tracker_id=tracker.id,tracker_name=tracker.name,tracker_key=tracker.keyName,tracker_type=tracker.type.name if tracker.type else "",tracker_version=tracker.version))
            await asyncio.gather(*(inspect(ref) for ref in refs))
        await asyncio.gather(*(process_project(p) for p in selected))
        descriptors.sort(key=lambda x:(x.project_name.casefold(),x.tracker_name.casefold(),x.tracker_id))
        return DiscoveryResult(instance_key=self.config.instance_key,projects_discovered=len(projects),projects_processed=len(selected),trackers_referenced=referenced,trackers_inspected=inspected,requirement_trackers=descriptors,failures=failures)


===== FILE: .\codebeamer_extractor\src\codebeamer_extractor\enrichment.py =====
"""Universal live item enrichment with independent optional evidence states."""
from __future__ import annotations
import asyncio
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Awaitable, Callable, TypeVar
from .diagnostics import CodebeamerError
from .models import (
    AttachmentsResponse,
    EnrichmentSection,
    ItemEnrichmentV2,
    RelationsResponse,
    SourceFailure,
    TrackerItem,
)

T = TypeVar("T")

class CodebeamerEnrichmentService:
    def __init__(self, client):
        self.client = client

    async def enrich(self, item_id: int, *, include_relations: bool = True, include_attachments: bool = True) -> ItemEnrichmentV2:
        retrieved_at = _now()
        item = await self.client.get_item(item_id)
        item_section = EnrichmentSection(status="loaded", retrievedAt=retrieved_at, count=1, data=item)

        relations_task = self._optional("item-relations", self.client.get_relations(item_id)) if include_relations else None
        attachments_task = self._optional("item-attachments", self.client.get_attachments(item_id)) if include_attachments else None
        pending = [task for task in (relations_task, attachments_task) if task is not None]
        completed = await asyncio.gather(*pending) if pending else []
        cursor = iter(completed)

        relations = next(cursor) if include_relations else EnrichmentSection(status="not-requested")
        attachments = next(cursor) if include_attachments else EnrichmentSection(status="not-requested")
        failures = [failure for section in (relations, attachments) for failure in section.failures]
        overall = "complete" if not failures else "partial-success"
        return ItemEnrichmentV2(status=overall, item=item_section, relations=relations, attachments=attachments, failures=failures, retrievedAt=retrieved_at)

    async def _optional(self, stage: str, operation: Awaitable[T]) -> EnrichmentSection:
        try:
            data = await operation
            count = _count(data)
            return EnrichmentSection(status="loaded-empty" if count == 0 else "loaded", retrievedAt=_now(), count=count, data=data)
        except CodebeamerError as exc:
            failure = exc.failure(stage)
            return EnrichmentSection(status="failed", retrievedAt=_now(), failures=[failure])
        except Exception as exc:
            failure = SourceFailure(stage=stage, classification="unexpected", message=str(exc), retryable=False)
            return EnrichmentSection(status="failed", retrievedAt=_now(), failures=[failure])

def _count(value: object) -> int:
    if isinstance(value, RelationsResponse): return value.itemCount
    if isinstance(value, AttachmentsResponse): return value.total
    return 1

def _now() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()


===== FILE: .\codebeamer_extractor\src\codebeamer_extractor\extractor.py =====
"""Complete paginated requirement extraction."""
from __future__ import annotations
import asyncio
from .client import CodebeamerClient
from .config import CodebeamerConfig
from .diagnostics import CodebeamerError, CodebeamerPaginationError
from .discovery import CodebeamerCatalogDiscoverer
from .models import ExtractionResult, RequirementTrackerDescriptor, TrackerExtraction

class CodebeamerRequirementExtractor:
    def __init__(self,client:CodebeamerClient,config:CodebeamerConfig): self.client=client; self.config=config
    async def extract_tracker(self,tracker:RequirementTrackerDescriptor)->TrackerExtraction:
        items={}; pages=duplicates=expected=0; previous_signature=None
        try:
            for page_number in range(1,self.config.max_pages+1):
                page=await self.client.query_tracker_items(tracker.tracker_id,page_number,self.config.page_size); pages+=1; expected=max(expected,page.total)
                signature=tuple(item.id for item in page.items)
                if not page.items: return TrackerExtraction(tracker=tracker,items=list(items.values()),pages_requested=pages,duplicate_items=duplicates,expected_total=expected,complete=len(items)>=expected)
                if signature==previous_signature: raise CodebeamerPaginationError(f"Repeated page detected for tracker {tracker.tracker_id} at page {page_number}.",operation="query-tracker-items",source_id=str(tracker.tracker_id))
                before=len(items)
                for item in page.items:
                    if item.id in items: duplicates+=1
                    items[item.id]=item
                if len(items)>=page.total or page.isLastPage is True: return TrackerExtraction(tracker=tracker,items=sorted(items.values(),key=lambda x:((x.ordinal or 10**9),x.id)),pages_requested=pages,duplicate_items=duplicates,expected_total=expected,complete=True)
                if len(items)==before: raise CodebeamerPaginationError(f"Pagination made no progress for tracker {tracker.tracker_id} at page {page_number}.",operation="query-tracker-items",source_id=str(tracker.tracker_id))
                previous_signature=signature
            raise CodebeamerPaginationError(f"Tracker {tracker.tracker_id} exceeded maximum page limit {self.config.max_pages}.",operation="query-tracker-items",source_id=str(tracker.tracker_id))
        except CodebeamerError as exc:
            return TrackerExtraction(tracker=tracker,items=sorted(items.values(),key=lambda x:x.id),pages_requested=pages,duplicate_items=duplicates,expected_total=expected,complete=False,failure=exc.failure("tracker"))
    async def extract_all(self,discoverer:CodebeamerCatalogDiscoverer|None=None)->ExtractionResult:
        discovery=await (discoverer or CodebeamerCatalogDiscoverer(self.client,self.config)).discover()
        semaphore=asyncio.Semaphore(self.config.max_concurrency)
        async def run(t):
            async with semaphore: return await self.extract_tracker(t)
        trackers=await asyncio.gather(*(run(t) for t in discovery.requirement_trackers))
        return ExtractionResult(instance_key=self.config.instance_key,trackers=list(trackers),discovery_failures=discovery.failures)

"""Deterministic requirement hierarchy construction."""
from .mapper import canonical_item_id
from .models import HierarchyEdge,NormalizedRequirement
def hierarchy_edge_id(instance_key:str,parent_id:int,child_id:int)->str:return f"codebeamer:{instance_key}:hierarchy:{parent_id}:{child_id}"
def build_hierarchy(requirements:list[NormalizedRequirement])->tuple[list[HierarchyEdge],int]:
    pairs=[]; by_id={r.item_id:r for r in requirements}; instance=requirements[0].source_instance if requirements else "unknown"
    for item in requirements:
        if item.parent_id is not None:pairs.append((item.parent_id,item.item_id))
        pairs.extend((item.item_id,child) for child in item.child_ids)
    unique=sorted(set(pairs)); duplicates=len(pairs)-len(unique)
    return [HierarchyEdge(id=hierarchy_edge_id(instance,p,c),source=canonical_item_id(instance,p),target=canonical_item_id(instance,c),parent_id=p,child_id=c,unresolved_parent=p not in by_id,unresolved_child=c not in by_id) for p,c in unique if p!=c],duplicates


===== FILE: .\codebeamer_extractor\src\codebeamer_extractor\mapper.py =====
"""Map Codebeamer items into stable normalized requirement documents."""
from __future__ import annotations
import html,re
from datetime import datetime,timezone
from typing import Any
from .models import NormalizedRequirement,RequirementTrackerDescriptor,TrackerItem
_TAG_RE=re.compile(r"<[^>]+>"); _WIKI_RE=re.compile(r"(?:\[\[|\]\]|\{\{|\}\}|''+)"); _WS_RE=re.compile(r"\s+")
def clean_text(value:str|None)->str:
    if not value:return ""
    return _WS_RE.sub(" ",_WIKI_RE.sub(" ",_TAG_RE.sub(" ",html.unescape(value)))).strip()
def canonical_item_id(instance_key:str,item_id:int)->str:return f"codebeamer:{instance_key}:item:{item_id}"
def _names(values:list[Any])->list[str]:return [clean_text(getattr(v,"name",None)) for v in values if clean_text(getattr(v,"name",None))]
def _custom(values:list[Any])->dict[str,str|int|float|bool]:
    out={}
    for value in values[:50]:
        if hasattr(value,"model_dump"):value=value.model_dump()
        if not isinstance(value,dict):continue
        key=str(value.get("name") or value.get("fieldName") or value.get("id") or "").strip(); raw=value.get("value")
        if key and isinstance(raw,(str,int,float,bool)):out[key]=clean_text(raw) if isinstance(raw,str) else raw
    return out
def map_requirement(item:TrackerItem,tracker:RequirementTrackerDescriptor,instance_key:str,synchronized_at:str|None=None)->NormalizedRequirement:
    synchronized_at=synchronized_at or datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    return NormalizedRequirement(source_instance=instance_key,canonical_id=canonical_item_id(instance_key,item.id),project_id=tracker.project_id,project_name=clean_text(tracker.project_name),tracker_id=tracker.tracker_id,tracker_name=clean_text(tracker.tracker_name),tracker_type=tracker.tracker_type,item_id=item.id,external_key=f"{tracker.tracker_key}-{item.id}" if tracker.tracker_key else str(item.id),type_name=item.typeName or "Requirement",name=clean_text(item.name),description=clean_text(item.description),status=clean_text(item.status.name) if item.status else None,priority=clean_text(item.priority.name) if item.priority else None,categories=_names(item.categories),severities=_names(item.severities),parent_id=item.parent.id if item.parent else None,parent_name=clean_text(item.parent.name) if item.parent else None,child_ids=[c.id for c in item.children],child_names=_names(item.children),version=item.version,ordinal=item.ordinal,created_at=item.createdAt,modified_at=item.modifiedAt,synchronized_at=synchronized_at,custom_fields=_custom(item.customFields))


===== FILE: .\codebeamer_extractor\src\codebeamer_extractor\models.py =====
"""Codebeamer transport, normalized catalog, and synchronization models."""
from __future__ import annotations
from typing import Any, Literal
from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field

class CBModel(BaseModel): model_config=ConfigDict(extra="allow",populate_by_name=True)
class Reference(CBModel): id:int; name:str; type:str|None=None
class ProjectReference(Reference): pass
class TrackerReference(Reference): pass
class UserReference(Reference): email:str|None=None
class ChoiceOptionReference(Reference): pass
class TrackerTypeReference(Reference): pass
class TrackerItemReference(Reference): testStepReuse:bool|None=None
class TrackerMetadata(CBModel):
    id:int; name:str; keyName:str|None=None; version:int|None=None; type:TrackerTypeReference|None=None; project:ProjectReference|None=None; deleted:bool=False; hidden:bool=False
class TrackerItem(CBModel):
    id:int; name:str; description:str|None=None; descriptionFormat:str|None=None; createdAt:str|None=None; createdBy:UserReference|None=None; modifiedAt:str|None=None; modifiedBy:UserReference|None=None; version:int|None=None; assignedTo:list[Reference]=Field(default_factory=list); parent:TrackerItemReference|None=None; tracker:TrackerReference|None=None; children:list[TrackerItemReference]=Field(default_factory=list); customFields:list[Any]=Field(default_factory=list); priority:ChoiceOptionReference|None=None; status:ChoiceOptionReference|None=None; categories:list[ChoiceOptionReference]=Field(default_factory=list); severities:list[ChoiceOptionReference]=Field(default_factory=list); teams:list[Reference]=Field(default_factory=list); versions:list[Reference]=Field(default_factory=list); ordinal:int|None=None; typeName:str|None=None; comments:list[Any]=Field(default_factory=list); tags:list[Any]=Field(default_factory=list)
class TrackerItemPage(CBModel): page:int=1; pageSize:int=25; total:int=0; items:list[TrackerItem]=Field(default_factory=list); isLastPage:bool|None=None
class TrackerItemReferencePage(CBModel): page:int=1; pageSize:int=25; total:int=0; itemRefs:list[TrackerItemReference]=Field(default_factory=list); isLastPage:bool|None=None
class RelationsResponse(CBModel): itemId:dict[str,Any]|None=None; downstreamReferences:list[Any]=Field(default_factory=list); upstreamReferences:list[Any]=Field(default_factory=list); incomingAssociations:list[Any]=Field(default_factory=list); outgoingAssociations:list[Any]=Field(default_factory=list); page:int=1; pageSize:int=500; itemCount:int=0; isLastPage:bool=True
class AttachmentReference(CBModel): id:int|None=None; name:str|None=None; fileName:str|None=None; mimeType:str|None=None; size:int|None=None
class AttachmentsResponse(CBModel): page:int=1; pageSize:int=0; total:int=0; attachments:list[AttachmentReference]=Field(default_factory=list)
