    provenance: {
      provider: "current-evidence-compatibility-adapter",
      sourceRecord: { source: value.identity.source, nativeId: `${value.identity.source}:${value.identity.operation}` },
      observedAt: value.observedAt,
    },
    payload: value.payload,
    warnings: value.warnings,
  };
}


===== FILE: .\OrchestrationPlatform\frontend\features\lattice-next\kernel\evidence\default-evidence-validator.ts =====
import type { EvidenceValidator } from "./evidence-validator";
import { issue } from "./evidence-validator";
import type { EvidenceCandidate, EvidenceIssue, EvidenceSchemaIdentity } from "./evidence-contracts";

export class BasicEvidenceValidator implements EvidenceValidator {
  readonly name = "lattice-basic-evidence-validator";
  constructor(readonly schema: EvidenceSchemaIdentity) {}
  validate(candidate: EvidenceCandidate): readonly EvidenceIssue[] {
    const issues: EvidenceIssue[] = [];
    if (!candidate.identity.investigationId) issues.push(issue("missing-investigation-id", "Investigation identity is required.", "identity.investigationId"));
    if (candidate.identity.revision < 1) issues.push(issue("invalid-investigation-revision", "Investigation revision must be positive.", "identity.revision"));
    if (!candidate.identity.executionId) issues.push(issue("missing-execution-id", "Execution identity is required.", "identity.executionId"));
    if (!candidate.identity.source.trim()) issues.push(issue("missing-source", "Evidence source is required.", "identity.source"));
    if (!candidate.provenance.provider.trim()) issues.push(issue("missing-provider", "Evidence provider is required.", "provenance.provider"));
    if (!Number.isFinite(Date.parse(candidate.capturedAt))) issues.push(issue("invalid-captured-at", "capturedAt must be an ISO timestamp.", "capturedAt"));
    if (!Number.isFinite(Date.parse(candidate.receivedAt))) issues.push(issue("invalid-received-at", "receivedAt must be an ISO timestamp.", "receivedAt"));
    if (candidate.payload === undefined) issues.push(issue("missing-payload", "Evidence payload cannot be undefined.", "payload"));
    if (["synthetic", "mocked", "hardcoded"].includes(candidate.authority))
      issues.push(issue("non-authoritative-evidence", `${candidate.authority} evidence is isolated from authoritative evidence.`, "authority", "warning"));
    if (candidate.authority === "unavailable" && candidate.completeness !== "unavailable")
      issues.push(issue("authority-completeness-conflict", "Unavailable evidence must declare unavailable completeness.", "completeness"));
    return issues;
  }
}


===== FILE: .\OrchestrationPlatform\frontend\features\lattice-next\kernel\evidence\evidence-acceptance-service.ts =====
import { hashEvidencePayload } from "./evidence-hasher";
import { asEvidenceId, type AcceptedEvidenceEnvelope, type EvidenceCandidate, type EvidenceDecision, type EvidenceIssue, type EvidenceValidationResult } from "./evidence-contracts";
import { EvidenceValidationRegistry, issue } from "./evidence-validator";

const evidenceIdFor = async (candidate: EvidenceCandidate, payloadHash: string) => {
  const identity = `${candidate.identity.investigationId}|${candidate.identity.revision}|${candidate.identity.executionId}|${candidate.identity.source}|${candidate.identity.operation}|${candidate.schema.name}|${candidate.schema.version}|${payloadHash}`;
  return asEvidenceId(`evidence:${(await hashEvidencePayload(identity)).replace("sha256:", "")}`);
};
const freeze = <T>(value: T): T => {
  if (value && typeof value === "object" && !Object.isFrozen(value)) {
    Object.freeze(value);
    for (const nested of Object.values(value as Record<string, unknown>)) freeze(nested);
  }
  return value;
};

export class EvidenceAcceptanceService {
  constructor(private readonly validators: EvidenceValidationRegistry, private readonly now: () => string = () => new Date().toISOString()) {}

  async evaluate<TPayload>(candidate: EvidenceCandidate<TPayload>): Promise<EvidenceDecision<TPayload>> {
    let payloadHash;
    const issues: EvidenceIssue[] = [];
    try { payloadHash = await hashEvidencePayload(candidate.payload); }
    catch (error) {
      payloadHash = await hashEvidencePayload({ hashingFailure: true });
      issues.push(issue("payload-not-canonicalizable", error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Evidence payload cannot be canonicalized.", "payload"));
    }
    const validator = this.validators.resolve(candidate.schema);
    if (!validator) issues.push(issue("validator-not-registered", `No validator is registered for ${candidate.schema.name}@${candidate.schema.version}.`, "schema"));
    else issues.push(...await validator.validate(candidate as EvidenceCandidate));
    const evidenceId = await evidenceIdFor(candidate, payloadHash);
    const validation: EvidenceValidationResult = {
      status: issues.some((item) => item.severity === "error") ? "rejected" : "accepted",
      schema: candidate.schema,
      validatedAt: this.now(),
      validator: validator?.name ?? "unregistered",
      issues,
    };
    const common = {
      evidenceId,
      investigationId: candidate.identity.investigationId,
      execution: candidate.identity,
      schema: candidate.schema,
      authority: candidate.authority,
      payloadHash,
      receivedAt: candidate.receivedAt,
      provenance: candidate.provenance,
      validation,
      warnings: [...candidate.warnings],
      payload: candidate.payload,
    };
    if (validation.status === "rejected") return freeze({ status: "rejected", ...common, validation: { ...validation, status: "rejected" as const } });
    const evidence: AcceptedEvidenceEnvelope<TPayload> = freeze({
      envelopeVersion: "2.0",
      ...common,
      investigationRevision: candidate.identity.revision,
      capturedAt: candidate.capturedAt,
      freshness: candidate.freshness,
      completeness: candidate.completeness,
      validation: { ...validation, status: "accepted" },
    });
    return { status: "accepted", evidence };
  }

  async verify(envelope: AcceptedEvidenceEnvelope): Promise<boolean> {
    return await hashEvidencePayload(envelope.payload) === envelope.payloadHash;
  }
}

===== FILE: .\OrchestrationPlatform\frontend\features\lattice-next\kernel\evidence\evidence-hasher.ts =====
import { asEvidencePayloadHash, type EvidencePayloadHash } from "./evidence-contracts";
import { stableJson } from "./stable-json";

export async function hashEvidencePayload(payload: unknown): Promise<EvidencePayloadHash> {
  const bytes = new TextEncoder().encode(stableJson(payload));
  const digest = await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", bytes);
  return asEvidencePayloadHash(`sha256:${[...new Uint8Array(digest)].map((value) => value.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("")}`);
}


===== FILE: .\OrchestrationPlatform\frontend\features\lattice-next\kernel\evidence\evidence-validator.ts =====
import type { EvidenceCandidate, EvidenceIssue, EvidenceSchemaIdentity } from "./evidence-contracts";

export interface EvidenceValidator<TPayload = unknown> {
  readonly schema: EvidenceSchemaIdentity;
  readonly name: string;
  validate(candidate: EvidenceCandidate<TPayload>): readonly EvidenceIssue[] | Promise<readonly EvidenceIssue[]>;
}

export class EvidenceValidationRegistry {
  private readonly validators = new Map<string, EvidenceValidator>();
  register(validator: EvidenceValidator): void {
    const key = this.key(validator.schema);
    if (this.validators.has(key)) throw new Error(`Evidence validator already registered for ${key}.`);
    this.validators.set(key, validator);
  }
  resolve(schema: EvidenceSchemaIdentity): EvidenceValidator | undefined {
    return this.validators.get(this.key(schema));
  }
  private key(schema: EvidenceSchemaIdentity): string { return `${schema.name}@${schema.version}`; }
}

export const issue = (code: string, message: string, path?: string, severity: EvidenceIssue["severity"] = "error"): EvidenceIssue => ({
  code, message, path, severity,
});

===== FILE: .\OrchestrationPlatform\frontend\features\lattice-next\kernel\evidence\stable-json.ts =====
function normalized(value: unknown, seen: WeakSet<object>): unknown {
  if (value === null || typeof value === "string" || typeof value === "boolean") return value;
  if (typeof value === "number") return Number.isFinite(value) ? value : String(value);
  if (typeof value === "bigint") return value.toString();
  if (value instanceof Date) return value.toISOString();
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.map((item) => normalized(item, seen));
  if (typeof value === "object") {
    if (seen.has(value)) throw new Error("Evidence payload contains a circular reference.");
    seen.add(value);
    const record = value as Record<string, unknown>;
    const output = Object.fromEntries(
      Object.keys(record).sort().flatMap((key) => {
        const current = record[key];
        return current === undefined || typeof current === "function" || typeof current === "symbol"
          ? []
          : [[key, normalized(current, seen)]];
      }),
    );
    seen.delete(value);
    return output;
  }
  return String(value);
}

export function stableJson(value: unknown): string {
  return JSON.stringify(normalized(value, new WeakSet<object>()));
}

  private base(id:string){ return path.join(evidenceRoot,"artifacts",safeSegment(id)); }
  async put(a:EvidenceArtifact):Promise<"created"|"existing"> { const base=this.base(a.artifactId); try { await fs.access(`${base}.bin`); return "existing"; } catch {} await atomicBytes(`${base}.bin`,a.bytes); await atomicJson(`${base}.meta.json`,{artifactId:a.artifactId,mediaType:a.mediaType,byteLength:a.bytes.byteLength}); return "created"; }

}

import path from "node:path";
import type { AcceptedEvidenceEnvelope, EvidenceId, EvidenceRejection } from "../evidence-contracts";
import type { EvidenceManifestEntry, EvidenceQuery, EvidenceRepository } from "../../ports/evidence-repository";
import { hashEvidencePayload } from "../evidence-hasher";
import { atomicJson, evidenceRoot, readJson, safeSegment } from "./evidence-storage-utils";

interface Manifest { version:1; entries:EvidenceManifestEntry[] }
export class EvidenceIntegrityError extends Error {}
export class FileEvidenceRepository implements EvidenceRepository {
  private record(id:string,status:"accepted"|"rejected"){return path.join(evidenceRoot,"records",status,`${safeSegment(id)}.json`);}
  private manifest(id:string,rev:number){return path.join(evidenceRoot,"investigations",safeSegment(id),String(rev),"manifest.json");}
  async putAccepted(e:AcceptedEvidenceEnvelope){return this.put(e,"accepted");}
  async putRejected(e:EvidenceRejection){return this.put(e,"rejected");}
  private async put(e:AcceptedEvidenceEnvelope|EvidenceRejection,status:"accepted"|"rejected"):Promise<"created"|"existing">{
    const file=this.record(e.evidenceId,status); const existing=await readJson<typeof e>(file);
    if(existing){if(existing.payloadHash!==e.payloadHash)throw new EvidenceIntegrityError(`Evidence ${e.evidenceId} is immutable and already exists with another hash.`);return "existing";}
    await atomicJson(file,e); const revision="investigationRevision" in e?e.investigationRevision:e.execution.revision; const mf=this.manifest(e.investigationId,revision); const current=await readJson<Manifest>(mf)??{version:1 as const,entries:[]};
    const entry:EvidenceManifestEntry={evidenceId:e.evidenceId,investigationId:e.investigationId,investigationRevision:revision,executionId:String(e.execution.executionId),source:e.execution.source,operation:e.execution.operation,authority:e.authority,schemaName:e.schema.name,schemaVersion:e.schema.version,payloadHash:e.payloadHash,status,storedAt:new Date().toISOString()};
    await atomicJson(mf,{version:1,entries:[...current.entries.filter(x=>x.evidenceId!==e.evidenceId),entry]}); return "created";
  }
  async getAccepted(id:EvidenceId){const e=await readJson<AcceptedEvidenceEnvelope>(this.record(id,"accepted"));if(e&&await hashEvidencePayload(e.payload)!==e.payloadHash)throw new EvidenceIntegrityError(`Evidence ${id} failed payload hash verification.`);return e;}
  async getRejected(id:EvidenceId){return readJson<EvidenceRejection>(this.record(id,"rejected"));}
  async query(q:EvidenceQuery){ const revisions=q.revision?[q.revision]:await this.revisions(q.investigationId); const all=(await Promise.all(revisions.map(async r=>(await readJson<Manifest>(this.manifest(q.investigationId,r)))?.entries??[]))).flat(); return all.filter(x=>(!q.executionId||x.executionId===q.executionId)&&(!q.source||x.source===q.source)).sort((a,b)=>a.storedAt.localeCompare(b.storedAt)); }
  private async revisions(id:string):Promise<number[]>{const {promises:fs}=await import("node:fs");const dir=path.join(evidenceRoot,"investigations",safeSegment(id));try{return(await fs.readdir(dir,{withFileTypes:true})).filter(x=>x.isDirectory()&&/^\d+$/.test(x.name)).map(x=>Number(x.name)).sort((a,b)=>a-b);}catch(e){if((e as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code==="ENOENT")return[];throw e;}}
}


===== FILE: .\OrchestrationPlatform\frontend\features\lattice-next\kernel\infrastructure\browser-investigation-event-store.ts =====
"use client";

import type { InvestigationEvent } from "../contracts/investigation-event";
import type { InvestigationId } from "../contracts/investigation-identity";
import type { InvestigationEventStore } from "../ports/investigation-event-store";

const PREFIX = "lattice-kernel:events:";

export class BrowserInvestigationEventStore implements InvestigationEventStore {
  async append(id: InvestigationId, events: readonly InvestigationEvent[], expectedSequence: number): Promise<void> {
    const current = await this.read(id);
    if (current.length !== expectedSequence) {
      throw new Error(`Event sequence conflict: expected ${expectedSequence}, found ${current.length}.`);
    }
    localStorage.setItem(`${PREFIX}${id}`, JSON.stringify([...current, ...events]));
  }

  async read(id: InvestigationId): Promise<readonly InvestigationEvent[]> {
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(`${PREFIX}${id}`);
      return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) as InvestigationEvent[] : [];
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  }
}


===== FILE: .\OrchestrationPlatform\frontend\features\lattice-next\kernel\infrastructure\browser-investigation-repository.ts =====
"use client";

import type { InvestigationId } from "../contracts/investigation-identity";
import type { InvestigationSnapshot } from "../contracts/investigation-snapshot";
import type { InvestigationRepository } from "../ports/investigation-repository";

const PREFIX = "lattice-kernel:snapshot:";

export class BrowserInvestigationRepository implements InvestigationRepository {
  async load<TCanonical = unknown>(id: InvestigationId): Promise<InvestigationSnapshot<TCanonical> | undefined> {
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(`${PREFIX}${id}`);
      return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) as InvestigationSnapshot<TCanonical> : undefined;
    } catch {
      return undefined;
    }
  }

  async save<TCanonical = unknown>(snapshot: InvestigationSnapshot<TCanonical>, expectedRevision: number): Promise<void> {
    const current = await this.load(snapshot.identity.investigationId);
    if (current && current.identity.revision !== expectedRevision) {
      throw new Error(`Investigation revision conflict: expected ${expectedRevision}, found ${current.identity.revision}.`);
    }
    localStorage.setItem(`${PREFIX}${snapshot.identity.investigationId}`, JSON.stringify(snapshot));
  }
}

===== FILE: .\OrchestrationPlatform\frontend\features\lattice-next\kernel\infrastructure\current-investigation-runtime.ts =====
"use client";

import type { LatticeHandoff } from "../../contracts/handoff";
import { isEngineeringIntelligenceInvestigationV1, type EngineeringIntelligenceInvestigationV1 } from "../../contracts/intelligence-v1";
import type { NormalizedSearchResult } from "../../discovery/contracts";
import { CurrentCanonicalAssemblyAdapter } from "../adapters/current-canonical-assembly-adapter";
import { CurrentSourceExecutionAdapter } from "../adapters/current-source-execution-adapter";
import { CanonicalPublicationCoordinator } from "../application/canonical-publication-coordinator";
import { SourceExecutionCoordinator } from "../application/source-execution-coordinator";
import type { InvestigationSnapshot } from "../contracts/investigation-snapshot";
import { BrowserInvestigationClock, BrowserInvestigationIdProvider } from "./browser-kernel-services";
import { HttpInvestigationAuthority } from "./http-investigation-authority";

export interface KernelInvestigationResult {
  snapshot: InvestigationSnapshot<EngineeringIntelligenceInvestigationV1>;
  canonical: EngineeringIntelligenceInvestigationV1;
  handoff: LatticeHandoff;
}

export function createCurrentInvestigationRuntime(handoffProvider?: (source: string) => Promise<LatticeHandoff | undefined>) {
  const ids = new BrowserInvestigationIdProvider();
  const clock = new BrowserInvestigationClock();
  const kernel = new HttpInvestigationAuthority();
  const executor = new CurrentSourceExecutionAdapter({
    getHandoff: async (command) => handoffProvider?.(command.selection.source),
  });
  const sourceCoordinator = new SourceExecutionCoordinator(kernel, executor, ids, clock);
  const publication = new CanonicalPublicationCoordinator<EngineeringIntelligenceInvestigationV1>(kernel, new CurrentCanonicalAssemblyAdapter(), clock);

  return {
    kernel,
    async investigate(selected: readonly NormalizedSearchResult[], subjectLabel: string): Promise<KernelInvestigationResult> {
      let snapshot = await kernel.create(
        subjectLabel,
        subjectLabel,
        selected.map((item) => ({
          source: item.source,
          nativeId: item.nativeId,
          displayName: item.displayName,
          metadata: {
            ...Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(item.sourceMetadata).flatMap(([key, value]) => value === null ? [] : [[key, String(value)]])),
            candidateId: item.resultId,
            canonicalId: item.resultId,
            entityType: item.entityType,
          },
        })),
      );
      const investigationId = snapshot.identity.investigationId;
      const execution = await sourceCoordinator.run(snapshot);
      snapshot = await publication.assembleAndPublish(execution.snapshot, execution.evidence);
      const canonical = snapshot.canonical?.value;
      if (!isEngineeringIntelligenceInvestigationV1(canonical)) {
        throw new Error(snapshot.warnings.at(-1) ?? "Investigation Kernel did not publish a valid canonical result.");
      }
      const handoff = executor.resolvedHandoff(String(investigationId), subjectLabel, snapshot.selections);
      if (!handoff) throw new Error("Investigation Kernel resolved no source structures.");
      return { snapshot: snapshot as InvestigationSnapshot<EngineeringIntelligenceInvestigationV1>, canonical, handoff };
    },
  };
}


===== FILE: .\OrchestrationPlatform\frontend\features\lattice-next\kernel\infrastructure\http-investigation-authority.ts =====
"use client";

import type { InvestigationCommand } from "../contracts/investigation-command";
import { asInvestigationId, type InvestigationId } from "../contracts/investigation-identity";
import type { InvestigationSnapshot } from "../contracts/investigation-snapshot";
import type { SourceSelection } from "../contracts/source-operation";
import type { InvestigationAuthorityPort } from "../ports/investigation-authority-port";

export class InvestigationAuthorityError extends Error {
  constructor(readonly status: number, message: string) { super(message); }
}

async function read<T>(response: Response): Promise<T> {
  const value = await response.json().catch(() => null);
  if (!response.ok) throw new InvestigationAuthorityError(response.status, value?.message ?? "Investigation authority request failed.");
  return value as T;
}

export class HttpInvestigationAuthority implements InvestigationAuthorityPort {
  constructor(private readonly baseUrl = "/api/lattice/investigations") {}

  async create(subjectLabel: string, query: string, selections: readonly SourceSelection[]): Promise<InvestigationSnapshot> {
    const response = await fetch(this.baseUrl, {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "content-type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ subjectLabel, query, selections }),
      cache: "no-store",
    });
    return read<InvestigationSnapshot>(response);
  }

  async dispatch(command: InvestigationCommand): Promise<InvestigationSnapshot> {
    if (command.type === "create") throw new Error("Creation must be requested from the server-owned create endpoint.");
    const id = investigationIdOf(command);
    const response = await fetch(`${this.baseUrl}/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`, {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "content-type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ command }),
      cache: "no-store",
    });
    return read<InvestigationSnapshot>(response);
  }

  async load(id: InvestigationId): Promise<InvestigationSnapshot | undefined> {
    const response = await fetch(`${this.baseUrl}/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`, { cache: "no-store" });
    if (response.status === 404) return undefined;
    return read<InvestigationSnapshot>(response);
  }
}

function investigationIdOf(command: Exclude<InvestigationCommand, { type: "create" }>): InvestigationId {
  if (command.type === "source-requested" || command.type === "source-started") return command.identity.investigationId;
  if (command.type === "source-completed") return command.result.identity.investigationId;
  return asInvestigationId(command.investigationId);
}

# Lattice Investigation Kernel - Phase 1

This package establishes the first executable slicing of Architecture Change #1 without changing the current UI, graph, layout, source routes, or extractors.

Included:

- Investigation and execution identity contracts
- Lifecycle and transition policy
- Source operation contracts
- Evidence envelope
- Completeness policy
- Stale-result guard
- Event reducer
- Repository and execution ports
- Deterministic in-memory testing adapters

Not yet integrated in this phase:

- Current source clients
- Current canonical assembly
- Browser persistence adapters
- React provider
- Workspace migration

The next phase wraps the current runtime behind the ports provided here.


===== FILE: .\OrchestrationPlatform\frontend\features\lattice-next\kernel\server\file-investigation-store.ts =====
import { promises as fs } from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import type { InvestigationEvent } from "../contracts/investigation-event";
import type { InvestigationId } from "../contracts/investigation-identity";
import type { InvestigationSnapshot } from "../contracts/investigation-snapshot";
import type { InvestigationEventStore } from "../ports/investigation-event-store";
import type { InvestigationRepository } from "../ports/investigation-repository";

const root = path.resolve(process.env.LATTICE_INVESTIGATION_DATA_DIR?.trim() || path.join(process.cwd(), ".lattice-data", "investigations"));
const safeId = (id: InvestigationId) => String(id).replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]/g, "_");
const snapshotPath = (id: InvestigationId) => path.join(root, safeId(id), "snapshot.json");
const eventsPath = (id: InvestigationId) => path.join(root, safeId(id), "events.json");

async function json<T>(file: string, fallback: T): Promise<T> {
  try { return JSON.parse(await fs.readFile(file, "utf8")) as T; }
  catch (error) { if ((error as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code === "ENOENT") return fallback; throw error; }
}
async function atomic(file: string, value: unknown): Promise<void> {
  await fs.mkdir(path.dirname(file), { recursive: true });
  const temporary = `${file}.${process.pid}.${crypto.randomUUID()}.tmp`;
  const handle = await fs.open(temporary, "w");
  try { await handle.writeFile(JSON.stringify(value), "utf8"); await handle.sync(); }
  finally { await handle.close(); }
  try { await retryTransient(() => fs.rename(temporary, file)); }
  finally { await fs.rm(temporary, { force: true }).catch(() => undefined); }
}
async function retryTransient(work: () => Promise<void>): Promise<void> {
  const delays = [25, 50, 100, 200, 400, 800, 1200, 1800];
  for (let attempt = 0; ; attempt++) {
    try { await work(); return; }
    catch (error) {
      const code = (error as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code;
      const transient = code === "EPERM" || code === "EBUSY" || code === "EACCES";
      if (!transient || attempt >= delays.length) throw new Error(transient ? "Investigation storage is temporarily locked after bounded retries." : error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Investigation persistence failed.");
      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, delays[attempt]));
    }
  }
}

export class FileInvestigationRepository implements InvestigationRepository {
  async load<TCanonical = unknown>(id: InvestigationId): Promise<InvestigationSnapshot<TCanonical> | undefined> {
    return json<InvestigationSnapshot<TCanonical> | undefined>(snapshotPath(id), undefined);
  }
  async save<TCanonical = unknown>(snapshot: InvestigationSnapshot<TCanonical>, expectedRevision: number): Promise<void> {
    const current = await this.load(snapshot.identity.investigationId);
    if (current && current.identity.revision !== expectedRevision)
      throw new Error(`Investigation revision conflict: expected ${expectedRevision}, found ${current.identity.revision}.`);
    await atomic(snapshotPath(snapshot.identity.investigationId), snapshot);
  }
}

export class FileInvestigationEventStore implements InvestigationEventStore {
  async append(id: InvestigationId, events: readonly InvestigationEvent[], expectedSequence: number): Promise<void> {
    const current = await this.read(id);
    if (current.length !== expectedSequence)
      throw new Error(`Event sequence conflict: expected ${expectedSequence}, found ${current.length}.`);
    await atomic(eventsPath(id), [...current, ...events]);
  }
  async read(id: InvestigationId): Promise<readonly InvestigationEvent[]> {
    return json<InvestigationEvent[]>(eventsPath(id), []);
  }
}

===== FILE: .\OrchestrationPlatform\frontend\features\lattice-next\kernel\testing\in-memory-event-store.ts =====
import type { InvestigationEvent } from "../contracts/investigation-event";
import type { InvestigationId } from "../contracts/investigation-identity";
import type { InvestigationEventStore } from "../ports/investigation-event-store";

export class InMemoryInvestigationEventStore implements InvestigationEventStore {
  private readonly streams = new Map<InvestigationId, InvestigationEvent[]>();

  async append(id: InvestigationId, events: readonly InvestigationEvent[], expectedSequence: number): Promise<void> {
    const current = this.streams.get(id) ?? [];
    if (current.length !== expectedSequence)
      throw new Error(`Event sequence conflict: expected ${expectedSequence}, found ${current.length}.`);
    this.streams.set(id, [...current, ...events]);
  }

  async read(id: InvestigationId): Promise<readonly InvestigationEvent[]> {
    return [...(this.streams.get(id) ?? [])];
  }
}


===== FILE: .\OrchestrationPlatform\frontend\features\lattice-next\kernel\testing\in-memory-investigation-repository.ts =====
import type { InvestigationId } from "../contracts/investigation-identity";
import type { InvestigationSnapshot } from "../contracts/investigation-snapshot";
import type { InvestigationRepository } from "../ports/investigation-repository";

export class InMemoryInvestigationRepository implements InvestigationRepository {
  private readonly values = new Map<InvestigationId, InvestigationSnapshot>();

  async load<TCanonical = unknown>(id: InvestigationId): Promise<InvestigationSnapshot<TCanonical> | undefined> {
    return this.values.get(id) as InvestigationSnapshot<TCanonical> | undefined;
  }

  async save<TCanonical = unknown>(snapshot: InvestigationSnapshot<TCanonical>, expectedRevision: number): Promise<void> {
    const current = this.values.get(snapshot.identity.investigationId);
    if (current && current.identity.revision !== expectedRevision)
      throw new Error(`Investigation revision conflict: expected ${expectedRevision}, found ${current.identity.revision}.`);
    this.values.set(snapshot.identity.investigationId, snapshot as InvestigationSnapshot);
  }
}

 const structuralKey=nodes.map(node=>node.id).sort().join("|")+"::"+edges.map(edge=>edge.id).sort().join("|");return{nodes:nodes.sort((a,b)=>a.id.localeCompare(b.id)),edges:edges.sort((a,b)=>a.id.localeCompare(b.id)),structuralKey,domainIds:INTELLIGENCE_DOMAINS.filter(domain=>nodes.some(node=>node.id===domainNodeId(domain.id))).map(domain=>domain.id),deferredCounts:Object.freeze(deferred)}
}

===== FILE: .\OrchestrationPlatform\frontend\features\lattice-next\projection\intelligence-visibility-policy.ts =====
import type { DomainExpansionLevel } from "./intelligence-projection-types";
export type VisibilityBudget={entities:number;includeEvidence:boolean;includeSecondary:boolean};
export function domainLevel(id:string,expanded:ReadonlySet<string>):DomainExpansionLevel{return expanded.has(`${id}:deep`)?"deep":expanded.has(id)?"expanded":"summary";}
export function visibilityBudget(level:DomainExpansionLevel,total:number):VisibilityBudget{if(level==="deep")return{entities:total,includeEvidence:true,includeSecondary:true};if(level==="expanded")return{entities:Math.min(total,24),includeEvidence:false,includeSecondary:true};return{entities:0,includeEvidence:false,includeSecondary:false};}
export function graphScalePolicy(nodes:number,relationships:number){const density=nodes?relationships/nodes:0;return nodes>500||density>8?{labels:false,maxPerDomain:12,deferEvidence:true}:nodes>150||density>4?{labels:true,maxPerDomain:24,deferEvidence:true}:{labels:true,maxPerDomain:60,deferEvidence:false};}

const payload = (id: number, customName: string) => ({
  intelligencePayload: {
    sourceExecutionId: `execution-${id}`,
    status: "success",
    evidence: {
      requirement: { canonicalId: `codebeamer:test:item:${id}`, itemId: id, externalKey: `REQ-${id}`, name: `Requirement ${id}`, status: "New", version: 1 },
      sourceContext: { projectId: 9, projectName: "Project", trackerId: 11, trackerName: "Requirements" },
      hierarchy: { parentName: null, childNames: [] },
      catalog: { revision: "revision", status: "complete", synchronizedAt: "2026-10-19T00:00:00Z" },
      liveEnrichment: {
        contractVersion: "2.0", status: "complete", retrievedAt: "2026-10-19T00:01:00Z",
        item: { status: "loaded", count: 1, retrievedAt: "2026-10-19T00:01:00Z", failures: [], data: { id, name: `Requirement ${id}`, typeName: "Requirement", customFields: [{ id: 81, name: customName, value: `Value ${id}` }] } },
        relations: { status: "loaded-empty", count: 0, retrievedAt: "2026-10-19T00:01:01Z", failures: [], data: {} },
        attachments: { status: "loaded-empty", count: 0, retrievedAt: "2026-10-19T00:01:02Z", failures: [], data: {} },
        failures: [],
      },
    },
    provenance: { provider: "codebeamer_extractor", observedAt: "2026-10-19T00:01:00Z" },
  },
});

describe("L-CB5C Codebeamer details projection", () => {
  it("preserves complete live evidence and loaded-empty semantics", () => {
    const result = projectCodebeamerIntelligence("investigation", payload(101, "Arbitrary Field"), "2026-10-19T00:02:00Z")!;
    const entity = result.entities.find((item) => item.id === "codebeamer:test:item:101")!;
    expect(entity.properties["codebeamer.evidence.contractVersion"].text).toBe("2.0");
    expect(entity.properties["codebeamer.evidence.item.status"].text).toBe("loaded");
    expect(entity.properties["codebeamer.evidence.relations.status"].text).toBe("loaded-empty");
    expect(entity.properties["codebeamer.evidence.attachments.count"].number).toBe(0);
    expect(entity.properties["codebeamer.custom.Arbitrary Field"].text).toContain("Value 101");
  });

  it("keeps evidence isolated for multiple requirements", () => {
    const first = projectCodebeamerIntelligence("first", payload(101, "Field A"), "2026-10-19T00:02:00Z")!;
    const second = projectCodebeamerIntelligence("second", payload(202, "Field B"), "2026-10-19T00:02:00Z")!;
    const merged = mergeSourceIntelligence([first, second]);
    const a = merged.entities.find((item) => item.id === "codebeamer:test:item:101")!;
    const b = merged.entities.find((item) => item.id === "codebeamer:test:item:202")!;
    expect(a.properties["codebeamer.custom.Field A"].text).toContain("101");
    expect(a.properties["codebeamer.custom.Field B"]).toBeUndefined();
    expect(b.properties["codebeamer.custom.Field B"].text).toContain("202");
  });
});

===== FILE: .\OrchestrationPlatform\frontend\features\lattice-next\tests\codebeamer-premium-node-ui.test.ts =====
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";
import { projectedNodeDimensions } from "../motion/node-sizing";
import { normalizeCodebeamerValue } from "../engines/codebeamer-display-value";
import type { ProjectedNode } from "../contracts/projection";

const node = (role: string, value = "", hasChildren = false): ProjectedNode => ({
  id: `node:${role}`,
  label: role === "detail-group" ? "Overview" : "Description",
  subtitle: role === "detail-group" ? "2 fields" : "Requirement description",
  kind: "requirement-detail",
  source: "codebeamer",
  level: 5,
  selected: false,
  expanded: false,
  hasChildren,
  hiddenChildren: hasChildren ? 2 : 0,
  attributes: { presentationRole: role, value },
  relationshipCount: 1,
  childCount: hasChildren ? 2 : 0,
});

describe("L-CB5D.3 premium Codebeamer node UI", () => {
  it("gives semantic group parents compact parent dimensions", () => {
    expect(projectedNodeDimensions(node("detail-group", "", true))).toEqual({ width: 360, height: 138 });
  });

  it("gives descriptions a wide contained card", () => {
    expect(projectedNodeDimensions(node("description", "x".repeat(500)))).toEqual({ width: 720, height: 238 });
    expect(projectedNodeDimensions(node("description", "x".repeat(260)))).toEqual({ width: 640, height: 238 });
    expect(projectedNodeDimensions(node("description", "x".repeat(120)))).toEqual({ width: 560, height: 238 });
  });

  it("keeps scalar detail leaves compact", () => {
    const dimensions = projectedNodeDimensions(node("detail-field", "Should have"));
    expect(dimensions.width).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(320);
    expect(dimensions.width).toBeLessThanOrEqual(520);
    expect(dimensions.height).toBe(148);
  });

  it("normalizes compact numbered prose into readable lines", () => {
    const result = normalizeCodebeamerValue("Supported configurations:1. Hydraulic2. Electric3. Manual");
    expect(result.text).toBe("Supported configurations:\n1. Hydraulic\n2. Electric\n3. Manual");
  });

  it("renders parent groups without scalar Unavailable output", () => {
    const source = readFileSync(fileURLToPath(new URL("../components/PremiumNodes.tsx", import.meta.url)), "utf8");
    const groupStart = source.indexOf("{isDetailGroup ? (");
    const leafStart = source.indexOf(") : isRequirementDetail ? (", groupStart);
    const groupBranch = source.slice(groupStart, leafStart);
    expect(groupBranch).toContain("{data.subtitle}");
    expect(groupBranch).toContain("{data.label}");
    expect(groupBranch).not.toContain("{value}");
    expect(groupBranch).not.toContain("Unavailable");
  });

  it("keeps Read more and Show less inside the description card", () => {
    const source = readFileSync(fileURLToPath(new URL("../components/PremiumNodes.tsx", import.meta.url)), "utf8");
    expect(source).toContain('overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain');
    expect(source).toContain('showFullValue ? "Show less" : "Read more"');
    expect(source).toContain("geometrySignal={showFullValue ? 1 : 0}");
  });

  it("makes the premium node fill and clip to the React Flow geometry", () => {
    const source = readFileSync(fileURLToPath(new URL("../components/PremiumNodes.tsx", import.meta.url)), "utf8");
    expect(source).toContain("flex h-full w-full min-w-0");
    expect(source).toContain("overflow-hidden rounded-2xl");
  });
});

function tree(prefix:string,total:number):TreeNodeData{let used=1;const root:TreeNodeData={id:`${prefix}-0`,name:`${prefix} assembly`,children:[]};const queue=[root];while(used<total){const parent=queue.shift()!;for(let i=0;i<5&&used<total;i++,used++){const assembly=used%4===0,node:TreeNodeData={id:`${prefix}-${used}`,name:`${assembly?"Assembly":"Part"} ${used}`,attributes:{"Item ID":`${prefix}-${used}`},children:assembly?[]:undefined};parent.children!.push(node);if(assembly)queue.push(node)}}return root}

===== FILE: .\OrchestrationPlatform\frontend\features\lattice-next\tests\investigation-reducer.test.ts =====

import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { initialInvestigation, investigationReducer } from "../state/investigation-reducer";

describe("investigation interaction reducer", () => {
  it("toggles a collapsed node open without clearing selection", () => {
    let state = initialInvestigation(["root"], ["unified", "teamcenter"]);
    state = investigationReducer(state, { type: "select-entity", id: "child" });
    state = investigationReducer(state, { type: "toggle", id: "child" });
    expect(state.interaction.expansion.expanded.has("child")).toBe(true);
    expect(state.interaction.selection).toEqual({ type: "entity", id: "child" });
  });

  it("toggles an initially expanded root closed", () => {
    let state = initialInvestigation(["root"], ["unified"]);
    expect(state.interaction.expansion.expanded.has("root")).toBe(true);
    state = investigationReducer(state, { type: "toggle", id: "root" });
    expect(state.interaction.expansion.expanded.has("root")).toBe(false);
  });

  it("collapses all requested descendants", () => {
    let state = initialInvestigation(["root"], ["unified"]);
    state = investigationReducer(state, { type: "expand-many", ids: ["root", "child", "leaf"] });
    state = investigationReducer(state, { type: "collapse-many", ids: ["root", "child", "leaf"] });
    expect([...state.interaction.expansion.expanded]).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("reset layout clears only pins and preserves expansion", () => {
    let state = initialInvestigation(["root"], ["unified"]);
    state = investigationReducer(state, { type: "toggle", id: "child" });
    state = investigationReducer(state, { type: "pin-position", id: "root", position: { x: 1, y: 2 } });
    state = investigationReducer(state, { type: "reset-layout" });
    expect(state.interaction.pinnedPositions).toEqual({});
    expect(state.interaction.expansion.expanded.has("child")).toBe(true);
    expect(state.interaction.expansion.expanded.has("root")).toBe(true);
  });


  it("starts a new investigation without clearing page-level source configuration", () => {
    let state = initialInvestigation(["root"], ["unified", "teamcenter"]);
    state = investigationReducer(state, { type: "select-entity", id: "child" });
    state = investigationReducer(state, { type: "pin-position", id: "child", position: { x: 12, y: 24 } });
    state = investigationReducer(state, { type: "query", value: "EYE HEAD" });
    const activeSources = state.activeSources;

    state = investigationReducer(state, { type: "start-new-investigation" });

    expect(state.query).toBe("");
    expect(state.inspectorOpen).toBe(false);
    expect(state.interaction.selection).toEqual({ type: "none" });
    expect(state.interaction.expansion.expanded.size).toBe(0);
    expect(state.interaction.expansion.focusRoot).toBeNull();
    expect(state.interaction.pinnedPositions).toEqual({});
    expect(state.interaction.hover).toEqual({ entityId: null, relationshipId: null });
    expect(state.activeSources).toBe(activeSources);
  });
});

===== FILE: .\OrchestrationPlatform\frontend\features\lattice-next\tests\layout-stability.test.ts =====
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import {
  classifyChange,
  createSession,
  stabilizeLayout,
} from "../layout/layout-session";
import type { RelationshipProjection } from "../contracts/projection";
import type { UniversalLayoutResult } from "../layout/layout-contract";
const projection = (ids: string[], key = "k"): RelationshipProjection => ({
  structuralKey: key,
  nodes: ids.map((id, i) => ({
    id,
    label: id,
    subtitle: id,
    kind: i ? "component" : "identity",
    source: "x",
    level: i,
    selected: false,
    expanded: true,
    hasChildren: false,
    hiddenChildren: 0,
    relationshipCount: 0,
    childCount: 0,
  })),
  edges: [],
});
const result = (ids: string[]): UniversalLayoutResult => ({
  signal: 1,
  revision: 2,
  positions: Object.fromEntries(ids.map((id, i) => [id, { x: i * 100, y: 0 }])),
  dimensions: Object.fromEntries(
    ids.map((id) => [id, { width: 50, height: 30 }]),
  ),
  ports: {},
  routes: {},
  branchBounds: ids[1]
    ? { [ids[1]]: { x: 100, y: 0, width: 50, height: 30 } }
    : {},
  branches: ids[1]
    ? [
        {
          id: ids[1],
          rootId: ids[1],
          nodeIds: ids.slice(1),
          edgeIds: [],
          direction: "RIGHT",
          angle: 0,
          bounds: { x: 100, y: 0, width: 50, height: 30 },
        },
      ]
    : [],
  radialConnections: {},
  diagnostics: {
    strategy: "sector-layered-v2",
    sourceCount: 1,
    rings: 1,
    iterations: 1,
    collisionsResolved: 0,
    elapsedMs: 1,
    overlapCount: 0,
    invalidCoordinateCount: 0,
    fallbackBranches: 0,
    nodeOverlapCount: 0,
    branchOverlapCount: 0,
    subjectIntrusionCount: 0,
    invalidRouteCount: 0,
  },
});
describe("incremental stability", () => {
  it("classifies expansion and collapse", () => {
    const before = createSession(result(["s", "a"]), projection(["s", "a"]), 1);
    expect(classifyChange(before, projection(["s", "a", "b"]), {})).toBe(
      "expand",
    );
    expect(classifyChange(before, projection(["s"]), {})).toBe("collapse");
  });
  it("preserves unchanged branch anchors", () => {
    const old = result(["s", "a"]);
    old.positions.a = { x: 500, y: 200 };
    old.branchBounds.a = { x: 500, y: 200, width: 50, height: 30 };
    const session = createSession(old, projection(["s", "a"]), 1);
    const next = result(["s", "a"]);
    const stable = stabilizeLayout(next, session, "filter");
    expect(stable.positions.a).toEqual({ x: 500, y: 200 });
  });
  it("tracks generations", () => {
    expect(
      createSession(result(["s"]), projection(["s"]), 42).layoutGeneration,
    ).toBe(42);
  });
});

===== FILE: .\OrchestrationPlatform\frontend\features\lattice-next\tests\radial-connection-geometry.test.ts =====
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import {
  radialConnectionGeometry,
  rectangleBoundaryAttachment,
} from "../layout/radial-connection-geometry";

const center = { x: 100, y: 100 };
const size = { width: 200, height: 100 };

function liesOnBoundary(point: { x: number; y: number }) {
  const onVertical =
    Math.abs(Math.abs(point.x - center.x) - size.width / 2) < 1e-8;
  const onHorizontal =
    Math.abs(Math.abs(point.y - center.y) - size.height / 2) < 1e-8;
  return onVertical || onHorizontal;
}

describe("radial rectangle connection geometry", () => {
  it.each([
    [0, "EAST", "WEST"],
    [Math.PI / 2, "SOUTH", "NORTH"],
    [Math.PI, "WEST", "EAST"],
    [-Math.PI / 2, "NORTH", "SOUTH"],
    [Math.PI / 4, "EAST", "WEST"],
    [(3 * Math.PI) / 4, "SOUTH", "NORTH"],
    [(-3 * Math.PI) / 4, "NORTH", "SOUTH"],
    [-Math.PI / 4, "EAST", "WEST"],
  ])(
    "allocates angle %s to opposing rectangle sides",
    (angle, sourceSide, targetSide) => {
      const result = radialConnectionGeometry({
        branchId: `branch-${angle}`,
        angle,
        sourceCenter: center,
        sourceSize: size,
        targetCenter: center,
        targetSize: size,
      });
      expect(result.source.side).toBe(sourceSide);
      expect(result.target.side).toBe(targetSide);
      expect(liesOnBoundary(result.source.position)).toBe(true);
      expect(liesOnBoundary(result.target.position)).toBe(true);
      expect(Number.isFinite(result.source.position.x)).toBe(true);
      expect(Number.isFinite(result.target.position.y)).toBe(true);
    },
  );

  it("keeps same-side branches on unique deterministic handles", () => {
    const first = radialConnectionGeometry({
      branchId: "a",
      angle: -0.35,
      sourceCenter: center,
      sourceSize: size,
      targetCenter: center,
      targetSize: size,
    });
    const second = radialConnectionGeometry({
      branchId: "b",
      angle: 0.35,
      sourceCenter: center,
      sourceSize: size,
      targetCenter: center,
      targetSize: size,
    });
    expect(first.source.side).toBe("EAST");
    expect(second.source.side).toBe("EAST");
    expect(first.source.id).toBe("radial-source:a");
    expect(second.source.id).toBe("radial-source:b");
    expect(first.source.offsetPercent).not.toBe(second.source.offsetPercent);
    expect(
      radialConnectionGeometry({
        branchId: "a",
        angle: -0.35,
        sourceCenter: center,
        sourceSize: size,
        targetCenter: center,
        targetSize: size,
      }),
    ).toEqual(first);
  });

  it("safely handles a zero direction component and clamps away from corners", () => {
    const result = rectangleBoundaryAttachment({
      id: "radial-source:zero",
      branchId: "zero",
      center,
      size,
      direction: { x: 0, y: -1 },
    });
    expect(result.side).toBe("NORTH");
    expect(result.position).toEqual({ x: 100, y: 50 });
    expect(result.offsetPercent).toBe(50);
    expect(result.offsetPercent).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(8);
    expect(result.offsetPercent).toBeLessThanOrEqual(92);
  });

  it("covers all four sides with eight deterministic branches", () => {
    const results = Array.from({ length: 8 }, (_, index) =>
      radialConnectionGeometry({
        branchId: `branch-${index}`,
        angle: -Math.PI / 2 + (index * Math.PI) / 4,
        sourceCenter: center,
        sourceSize: size,
        targetCenter: center,
        targetSize: size,
      }),
    );
    expect(new Set(results.map((result) => result.source.side))).toEqual(
      new Set(["NORTH", "EAST", "SOUTH", "WEST"]),
    );
    expect(new Set(results.map((result) => result.source.id)).size).toBe(8);
  });
});

import { radialChildPositions } from "../infrastructure/hybrid-layout-planner";
const angle=(p:{x:number;y:number})=>Math.atan2(p.y,p.x);

===== FILE: .\OrchestrationPlatform\frontend\features\lattice-next\tests\radial-route-adapter.test.ts =====
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { applyRadialFirstHopRoutes } from "../layout/radial-route-adapter";
import type { RadialLayoutConnection } from "../layout/layout-contract";

const connection: RadialLayoutConnection = {
  branchId: "branch-a",
  angle: Math.PI,
  sourceNodeId: "subject",
  targetNodeId: "branch-a",
  edgeId: "edge-a",
  source: { id: "radial-source:branch-a", nodeId: "subject", branchId: "branch-a", side: "WEST", offsetPercent: 50, position: { x: 10, y: 20 } },
  target: { id: "radial-target:branch-a", nodeId: "branch-a", branchId: "branch-a", side: "EAST", offsetPercent: 50, position: { x: -100, y: 20 } },
};

describe("radial first-hop route adaptation", () => {
  it("replaces a synthetic hub route with exact radial endpoints", () => {
    const result = applyRadialFirstHopRoutes({
      "edge-a": { edgeId: "edge-a", start: { x: 100, y: 20 }, bends: [{ x: 180, y: 20 }], end: { x: -90, y: 20 }, family: "structure" },
    }, { "edge-a": connection });
    expect(result["edge-a"].start).toEqual(connection.source.position);
    expect(result["edge-a"].end).toEqual(connection.target.position);
    expect(result["edge-a"].bends).toEqual([]);
    expect(result["edge-a"].label).toEqual({ x: -45, y: 20 });
  });

    const second = applyRadialFirstHopRoutes(routes, { "edge-a": connection });

import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import type { RelationshipProjection } from "../contracts/projection";
import { decomposeProjection } from "../layout/branch-decomposition";
import { buildElkBranchGraph } from "../layout/elk-branch-builder";
import { boundsOverlap, sectorAngles, usableViewport } from "../layout/sector-orchestrator";
import { hybridLayout } from "../infrastructure/hybrid-layout-planner";

const projection = (branches: number, depth = 3, width = 2): RelationshipProjection => {
  const nodes: RelationshipProjection["nodes"] = [{ id:"subject",label:"Subject",subtitle:"Universal",kind:"identity",source:"unified",level:0,selected:false,expanded:true,hasChildren:true,hiddenChildren:0,relationshipCount:branches,childCount:branches }];
  const edges: RelationshipProjection["edges"] = [];
  for (let branch=0; branch<branches; branch++) {
    let parents=["subject"];
    for (let level=1; level<=depth; level++) {
      const next:string[]=[];
      for (const parent of parents) for (let child=0; child<width; child++) {
        const id=`b${branch}-l${level}-${parent}-${child}`; next.push(id);
        nodes.push({id,label:id,subtitle:"Generated",kind:level===depth?"component":"assembly",source:`source-${branch}`,level,selected:false,expanded:true,hasChildren:level<depth,hiddenChildren:0,relationshipCount:1,childCount:level<depth?width:0});
        edges.push({id:`e:${parent}:${id}`,source:parent,target:id,kind:parent==="subject"?"represented-by":"contains",selected:false});
      }
      parents=next;
    }
  }
  return {nodes,edges,structuralKey:`${branches}:${depth}:${width}`};
};

describe("universal sector-layered architecture",()=>{
  it("decomposes arbitrary topology into primary branches",()=>{const graph=projection(5,2,2);const result=decomposeProjection(graph)!;expect(result.subjectId).toBe("subject");expect(result.branches).toHaveLength(10);expect(new Set(result.branches.flatMap(b=>b.nodeIds)).size).toBe(graph.nodes.length-1);});
  it("builds deterministic ELK graphs with explicit ordered ports",()=>{const graph=projection(2,2,1);const branch=decomposeProjection(graph)!.branches[0];const a=buildElkBranchGraph(branch,graph,"RIGHT");const b=buildElkBranchGraph(branch,graph,"RIGHT");expect(a).toEqual(b);expect(a.children.every(n=>n.ports.length===2)).toBe(true);expect(a.layoutOptions["elk.edgeRouting"]).toBe("ORTHOGONAL");});
  it("allocates exact 360/n sectors for any branch count",()=>{const values=sectorAngles(["d","a","c","b"]);const gaps=values.map((v,i)=>((values[(i+1)%values.length].angle-v.angle+Math.PI*2)%(Math.PI*2)));expect(gaps.every(g=>Math.abs(g-Math.PI/2)<1e-9)).toBe(true);});
  it("accounts for inspector, toolbar and gutters",()=>{expect(usableViewport({width:1600,height:1000,inspectorWidth:400,toolbarHeight:100,gutter:50})).toMatchObject({width:1100,height:800,center:{x:550,y:400}});});
  it("composes a complete deterministic non-overlapping investigation",async()=>{const graph=projection(4,3,2);const a=await hybridLayout(graph,{},1,{width:1800,height:1200,inspectorWidth:360});const b=await hybridLayout(graph,{},1,{width:1800,height:1200,inspectorWidth:360});expect(a.positions).toEqual(b.positions);expect(Object.keys(a.positions)).toHaveLength(graph.nodes.length);expect(a.diagnostics.invalidCoordinateCount).toBe(0);for(let i=0;i<a.branches.length;i++)for(let j=i+1;j<a.branches.length;j++)expect(boundsOverlap(a.branches[i].bounds,a.branches[j].bounds,0)).toBe(false);});
});


describe("production layout invariants",()=>{
  it("returns valid ELK ports and finite routed structural edges",async()=>{const graph=projection(3,3,2);const result=await hybridLayout(graph,{},9,{width:1700,height:1050});expect(Object.keys(result.ports).length).toBeGreaterThan(0);expect(Object.keys(result.routes).length).toBeGreaterThan(0);expect(result.diagnostics.invalidRouteCount).toBe(0);for(const port of Object.values(result.ports)){expect(result.positions[port.nodeId]).toBeDefined();expect(Number.isFinite(port.position.x)&&Number.isFinite(port.position.y)).toBe(true)}});

  it("handles zero and one branch without invalid geometry",async()=>{for(const count of [0,1]){const result=await hybridLayout(projection(count,2,1),{},count);expect(result.diagnostics.invalidCoordinateCount).toBe(0);expect(Object.values(result.positions).every(point=>Number.isFinite(point.x)&&Number.isFinite(point.y))).toBe(true)}});
  it("honors a valid pin without losing graph coordinates",async()=>{const graph=projection(2,2,1);const target=graph.nodes[1].id;const result=await hybridLayout(graph,{[target]:{x:91,y:37}},7);expect(result.positions[target]).toEqual({x:91,y:37});expect(Object.keys(result.positions)).toHaveLength(graph.nodes.length);});
});

/* eslint-disable react-hooks/set-state-in-effect */
"use client";

import {

  motion,
  useReducedMotion,
} from "motion/react";

  IconAlertTriangle,
  IconArrowLeft,
  IconChevronLeft,
  IconSearch,
  IconX,
} from "@tabler/icons-react";

import type { EngineeringIntelligenceInvestigationV1 } from "../contracts/intelligence-v1";
import { createInvestigationGraphCore } from "../engines/investigation-graph";

import {
  initialInvestigation,
  investigationReducer,
} from "../state/investigation-reducer";

  saveInvestigation,
} from "../persistence/investigation-store";
import { RelationshipCanvas } from "../components/RelationshipCanvas";
import { LatticeFlowProvider } from "../canvas/LatticeFlowProvider";
import { EntityInspector } from "../components/EntityInspector";
import { IntelligenceInspector } from "../components/IntelligenceInspector";
import { IntelligenceLegend } from "../components/IntelligenceLegend";
import { RelationshipInspector } from "../components/RelationshipInspector";
import { InvestigationToolbar } from "../components/InvestigationToolbar";
import { downloadHierarchicalLatticeJson } from "../export/hierarchical-json-export";
import type {
  HandoffReadResult,
  LatticeHandoff,
  LatticeSourceEnvelope,
} from "../contracts/handoff";
import { DiscoveryWorkspace } from "../discovery/DiscoveryWorkspace";

  createDirectInvestigation,
  handoffInvestigationShell,
} from "../discovery/investigation";

  listCanonicalInvestigations,
  loadCanonicalInvestigation,
  saveCanonicalInvestigation,
} from "../persistence/canonical-investigation-store";

type CanonicalInvestigation = NonNullable<
  ReturnType<typeof loadCanonicalInvestigation>
>;

export function LatticeNextWorkspace() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const params = useSearchParams();
  const handoffId = params.get("handoff");
  const investigationId = params.get("investigation");

  const [direct, setDirect] = useState<LatticeHandoff | null>(null);
  const [directCanonical, setDirectCanonical] =
    useState<EngineeringIntelligenceInvestigationV1 | null>(null);
  const [message, setMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [serverRestored, setServerRestored] = useState<{ handoff: LatticeHandoff; canonical: EngineeringIntelligenceInvestigationV1 } | null>(null);
  const [serverRestorePending, setServerRestorePending] = useState(Boolean(investigationId));
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!investigationId || direct) { setServerRestorePending(false); return; }
    let active = true;
    const authority = new HttpInvestigationAuthority();
    void authority.load(asInvestigationId(investigationId)).then((snapshot) => {
      if (!active) return;
      const canonical = snapshot?.canonical?.value;
      if (!snapshot || !isEngineeringIntelligenceInvestigationV1(canonical)) {
        setServerRestorePending(false);
        return;
      }
      const createdAt = snapshot.createdAt;
      setServerRestored({
        canonical,
        handoff: {
          version: 2,
          handoffId: String(snapshot.identity.investigationId),
          createdAt,
          expiresAt: new Date(Date.parse(createdAt) + 365 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString(),
          subjectLabel: snapshot.subjectLabel,
          sources: snapshot.selections.map((selection) => ({
            source: selection.source as LatticeSourceEnvelope["source"],
            label: selection.source,
            nativeId: selection.nativeId,
            completeness: snapshot.completeness.failedSources.includes(selection.source) ? "partial" : "complete",
            root: { id: `${selection.source}:${selection.nativeId}`, name: selection.displayName, attributes: { "Item ID": selection.nativeId }, children: [] },
          })),
        },
      });
      setServerRestorePending(false);
    }).catch((error) => {
      if (active) { setMessage(error instanceof Error ? error.message : "The durable investigation could not be restored."); setServerRestorePending(false); }
    });
    return () => { active = false; };
  }, [investigationId, direct]);

  const [handoff] = useState<HandoffReadResult | null>(() =>
    handoffId ? readHandoff(handoffId) : null,
  );
  const [restored] = useState<CanonicalInvestigation | null>(() =>
    investigationId ? loadCanonicalInvestigation(investigationId) : null,
  );

  const startNewInvestigation = useCallback(() => {
    setDirect(null);
    setDirectCanonical(null);
    setMessage(null);
    router.replace("/lattice");
  }, [router]);

  if (direct) {
    return (
      <Investigation
        handoffId={direct.handoffId}
        handoff={direct}
        canonical={directCanonical}
        onStartNew={startNewInvestigation}
      />
    );
  }

  if (serverRestored) {
    return <Investigation handoffId={serverRestored.handoff.handoffId} handoff={serverRestored.handoff} canonical={serverRestored.canonical} onStartNew={startNewInvestigation} />;
  }
  if (serverRestorePending) {
    return <main className="flex min-h-[calc(100vh-64px)] items-center justify-center bg-slate-950 text-sm text-slate-400">Restoring durable investigation...</main>;
  }
  if (handoffId) {
    return handoff?.ok ? (
      <Investigation
        handoffId={handoff.value.handoffId}
        handoff={handoff.value}
        onStartNew={startNewInvestigation}
      />
    ) : (
      <Recovery
        message={handoff?.message ?? "The contextual handoff is unavailable."}
      />
    );
  }

  if (restored) {
    return <Restored canonical={restored} />;
  }

  return (
    <>
      <DiscoveryWorkspace
        onInvestigate={async (selected, subjectLabel) => {
          const runtime = createCurrentInvestigationRuntime();
          const toastId = toast.loading("Creating engineering investigation", { description: "Preparing selected source evidence and opening the governed investigation workflow." });
          try {
            const result = await runtime.investigate(
              selected,
              subjectLabel || selected[0]?.displayName || "Engineering investigation",
            );
            buildIntelligenceInvestigation(result.canonical);
            setDirectCanonical(result.canonical);
            setDirect(result.handoff);
            router.replace(`/lattice?investigation=${encodeURIComponent(String(result.snapshot.identity.investigationId))}`);
            toast.success("Investigation ready", { id: toastId, description: "Canonical evidence passed validation and the investigation workspace is opening." });
            if (result.snapshot.lifecycle === "partial" || result.snapshot.completeness.overall === "partial") {
              const limitation = result.snapshot.completeness.limitations.join(" | ") || "The investigation completed with partial source evidence.";
              setMessage(limitation);
              toast.warning("Investigation opened with partial evidence", { description: limitation });
            }
          } catch (cause) {
            const technicalDetail = cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : "The Investigation Kernel could not complete the investigation.";
            const detail = /[A-Z]:\\|EPERM|EBUSY|EACCES/i.test(technicalDetail) ? "Investigation persistence is temporarily unavailable. Retry after the file lock clears." : technicalDetail;
            console.error("Lattice investigation failure", cause);
            setMessage(detail);
            toast.error("Investigation could not be created", { id: toastId, description: detail });
          }
        }}
      />
    </>
  );
}

function Restored({ canonical }: { canonical: CanonicalInvestigation }) {
  return (
    <main className="flex min-h-[calc(100vh-64px)] items-center justify-center bg-slate-950 p-6 text-white">
      <section className="max-w-lg rounded-xl border border-slate-800 bg-slate-900 p-7 text-center">
        <h1 className="text-xl font-semibold">{canonical.rootContext.label}</h1>
        <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-slate-400">
          The investigation metadata was restored. Reopen from a contextual
          source or start a new investigation to refresh source structures.
        </p>
        <Link
          href="/lattice"
          className="mt-5 inline-flex rounded-lg bg-cyan-600 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold"
        >
          New investigation
        </Link>
      </section>
    </main>
  );
}

function Investigation({
  handoffId,
  handoff,
  onStartNew,
  canonical,
}: {
  handoffId: string;
  onStartNew: () => void;
  canonical?: EngineeringIntelligenceInvestigationV1 | null;
  handoff: Extract<HandoffReadResult, { ok: true }>["value"] | LatticeHandoff;
}) {
  const reducedMotion = useReducedMotion();
  const [workspaceFullscreen, setWorkspaceFullscreen] = useState(false);
  const [arranging, setArranging] = useState(false);
  const domain = useMemo(
    () =>
      canonical
        ? buildIntelligenceInvestigation({
            ...canonical,
            subject: {
              ...canonical.subject,
              displayName: handoff.subjectLabel || canonical.subject.displayName,
            },
          })
        : buildInvestigation(handoff),
    [canonical, handoff],
  );
  const core = useMemo(() => createInvestigationGraphCore(domain), [domain]);
  const sources = useMemo(
    () => [...new Set(domain.entities.map((entity) => entity.source))],
    [domain.entities],
  );

  const [state, dispatch] = useReducer(
    investigationReducer,
    undefined,
    () =>
      loadInvestigation(handoffId, domain, sources) ??
      initialInvestigation(domain.roots, sources),
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    saveInvestigation(handoffId, state);
  }, [handoffId, state]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const toggle = () => setWorkspaceFullscreen((value) => !value);
    window.addEventListener("lattice:toggle-workspace-fullscreen", toggle);
    return () =>
      window.removeEventListener("lattice:toggle-workspace-fullscreen", toggle);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const previousBodyOverflow = document.body.style.overflow;
    const previousHtmlOverflow = document.documentElement.style.overflow;

    document.body.style.overflow = "hidden";
    document.documentElement.style.overflow = "hidden";

    return () => {
      document.body.style.overflow = previousBodyOverflow;
      document.documentElement.style.overflow = previousHtmlOverflow;
    };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!workspaceFullscreen) return;
    const onKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (event.key === "Escape") setWorkspaceFullscreen(false);
    };
    window.addEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
  }, [workspaceFullscreen]);

  const startNewInvestigation = useCallback(() => {
    dispatch({ type: "start-new-investigation" });
    clearInvestigation(handoffId);
    onStartNew();
  }, [handoffId, onStartNew]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const existing = loadCanonicalInvestigation(`lattice-${handoff.handoffId}`);
    if (!existing) {
      saveCanonicalInvestigation(handoffInvestigationShell(handoff, domain));
    }
  }, [domain, handoff]);

  const projection = useMemo(
    () =>
      projectVisibleGraph(domain, core, {
        expanded: state.interaction.expansion.expanded,
        selection: state.interaction.selection,
        query: state.query,
        focusRoot: state.interaction.expansion.focusRoot,
        sources: state.activeSources,
        relationships: state.activeRelationships,
      }),
    [
      domain,
      core,
      state.interaction.expansion.expanded,
      state.interaction.selection,
      state.interaction.expansion.focusRoot,
      state.query,
      state.activeSources,
      state.activeRelationships,
    ],
  );

  const entity =
    state.interaction.selection.type === "entity"
      ? (domain.byId[state.interaction.selection.id] ?? null)
      : null;
  const relationship =
    state.interaction.selection.type === "relationship"
      ? (domain.relationshipById[state.interaction.selection.id] ?? null)
      : null;
  const related = entity
    ? domain.relationships.filter(

                projection={projection}
                orientation={state.orientation}
                pinnedPositions={state.interaction.pinnedPositions}
                viewport={state.interaction.viewport}
                layoutMode={state.interaction.layoutMode}
                onBilateralReflow={(positions) => { dispatch({ type: "bilateral-reflow", positions }); setArranging(false); }}
                onBilateralReflowStart={() => setArranging(true)}
                onCollapseAll={() => dispatch({ type: "collapse-all" })}
                onSelectEntity={(id) => dispatch({ type: "select-entity", id })}
                onSelectRelationship={(id) =>
                  dispatch({ type: "select-relationship", id })
                }
                onToggle={(id) => dispatch({ type: "toggle", id })}
                onViewport={(value) => dispatch({ type: "viewport", value })}
                onPinPosition={(id, position) =>
                  dispatch({ type: "pin-position", id, position })
                }
                onClearTransient={() => dispatch({ type: "clear-transient" })}
                onEscape={() =>
                  state.inspectorOpen
                    ? dispatch({ type: "close-inspector" })
                    : dispatch({ type: "clear-transient" })
                }
                onNodeAction={({ nodeId, action }) => {
                  if (action === "focus")
                    dispatch({ type: "focus", id: nodeId });
                  else if (
                    action === "expand-one" &&
                    !state.interaction.expansion.expanded.has(nodeId)
                  )
                    dispatch({ type: "toggle", id: nodeId });
                  else if (action === "expand-branch")
                    dispatch({
                      type: "expand-many",
                      ids: [nodeId, ...core.descendants(nodeId)],
                    });
                  else if (action === "collapse-descendants")
                    dispatch({
                      type: "collapse-many",
                      ids: [nodeId, ...core.descendants(nodeId)],
                    });
                  else if (action === "reset-position")
                    dispatch({ type: "unpin-position", id: nodeId });
                  else if (
                    action === "toggle-pin" &&
                    state.interaction.pinnedPositions[nodeId]
                  )
                    dispatch({ type: "unpin-position", id: nodeId });
                  else if (action === "open-details")
                    dispatch({ type: "select-entity", id: nodeId });
                  else if (action === "trace-upstream")
                    dispatch({
                      type: "expand-many",
                      ids: core.ancestors(nodeId),
                    });
                  else if (action === "trace-downstream")
                    dispatch({
                      type: "expand-many",
                      ids: core.descendants(nodeId),
                    });
                  else if (action === "compare-representations")
                    dispatch({ type: "focus", id: domain.roots[0] ?? null });
                }}
                onEdgeAction={({ edgeId, action }) => {
                  const relationship = domain.relationships.find(
                    (item) => item.id === edgeId,
                  );
                  if (!relationship) return;
                  if (action === "hide-family")
                    dispatch({
                      type: "relationship",
                      value: relationship.kind,
                    });
                  else if (action === "trace") {
                    dispatch({
                      type: "expand-many",
                      ids: [
                        relationship.from,
                        relationship.to,
                        ...core.ancestors(relationship.from),
                        ...core.descendants(relationship.to),
                      ],
                    });
                    dispatch({ type: "select-relationship", id: edgeId });
                  } else if (action === "compare-endpoints")
                    dispatch({
                      type: "expand-many",
                      ids: [relationship.from, relationship.to],
                    });
                  else dispatch({ type: "select-relationship", id: edgeId });
                }}
              />
            </LatticeFlowProvider>
          </div>

          <AnimatePresence initial={false}>
            {state.inspectorOpen ? (
              <motion.aside
                key="lattice-inspector-panel"
                id="lattice-inspector-panel"
                initial={
                  reducedMotion ? { opacity: 1 } : { x: 340, opacity: 0 }
                }
                animate={{ x: 0, opacity: 1 }}
                exit={reducedMotion ? { opacity: 0 } : { x: 340, opacity: 0 }}
                transition={{
                  type: "spring",
                  stiffness: 300,
                  damping: 32,
                  mass: 0.85,
                }}
                className="relative min-w-0 overflow-hidden border-l border-slate-800"
              >
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => dispatch({ type: "close-inspector" })}
                  aria-label="Close details"
                  className="absolute right-3 top-3 z-20 rounded-lg border border-slate-700 bg-slate-950/90 p-1.5 text-slate-400 hover:text-white"
                >
                  <IconX className="h-4 w-4" />
                </button>
                {relationship ? (
                  <RelationshipInspector
                    relationship={relationship}
                    source={domain.byId[relationship.from]}
                    target={domain.byId[relationship.to]}
                  />
                ) : domain.metadata?.contractVersion ? (
                  <IntelligenceInspector graph={domain} entity={entity} />
                ) : (
                  <EntityInspector entity={entity} relationships={related} />
                )}
              </motion.aside>
            ) : null}
          </AnimatePresence>

          {!state.inspectorOpen ? (
            <motion.button
              initial={reducedMotion ? undefined : { x: 16, opacity: 0 }}
              animate={{ x: 0, opacity: 1 }}
              type="button"
              onClick={() => dispatch({ type: "open-inspector" })}
              aria-expanded="false"
              aria-controls="lattice-inspector-panel"
              className="absolute right-3 top-3 z-20 inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg border border-slate-700 bg-slate-950/90 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-300 shadow-xl"
            >
              <IconChevronLeft className="h-4 w-4" /> Details
            </motion.button>
          ) : null}
        </motion.section>
      </main>
    </MotionConfig>
  );
}

function Recovery({ message }: { message: string }) {

namespace ConfigitAceIntegration.Abstractions;

/// <summary>

{

    /// Validates the extracted Teamcenter data for schema compliance and integrity.
    /// </summary>

    /// <returns>Validation result with errors if any</returns>

    /// <summary>
    /// Validates the transformed BOM structure for Configit compliance.
    /// </summary>
